valve_text: Return: Centaur Warrunner has +2 Retaliate.
zh_text: 胆大如斗：姜维+2反击。
en_text: Gall Like a Bushel: Jiang Wei has +2 retaliate.
rationale: When Jiang Wei died his gall was found to be 'as big as a 斗' (世语), so he punishes anyone who strikes him. His nine all-out northern campaigns, all offence and no defence, are Double Edge (+8 attack / -8 armor).
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/jiangwei.png: Jiang Wei, Shu's last great general, spear raised against a crimson dusk.

valve_text: Reactive Armor: Timbersaw has +1 Armor for each of its attackers. Timbersaw's attackers have -1 Armor.
zh_text: 龙胆：每有一个单位攻击赵云，赵云+1护甲。攻击赵云的单位-1护甲。
en_text: Dragon's Courage: Zhao Yun has +1 armor for each of his attackers. Zhao Yun's attackers have -1 armor.
rationale: The more enemies surround Zhao Yun, the harder he is to kill, as at Changban where he cut through Cao's ranks again and again (三国杀 龙胆). Avoids the mapped 一身是胆 and 长坂怒喝.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/zhaoyun.png: Zhao Yun in silver armour on a white horse, spear sweeping through mist.

valve_text: Ravage: Stun Tidehunter's enemy neighbors this round and each other enemy has a 50% chance of being stunned this round.
zh_text: 铁索连舟：本回合眩晕庞统的敌方邻位单位，其他每个敌方单位各有50%几率在本回合被眩晕。主动技能，冷却4。
en_text: Chained Warships: stun Pang Tong's enemy neighbors this round. Each other enemy has a 50% chance of being stunned this round. Active ability; cooldown 4.
rationale: In 演义 ch.47 Pang Tong persuades Cao Cao to chain his fleet together, leaving it unable to move: a field-wide stun. This is a different event from the mapped 连环计 (Wang Yun's Diaochan scheme). He cleared a hundred days of Leiyang cases in half a day (ch.57), the cheap 'get initiative' signature.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/pangtong.png: Pang Tong, plain-faced strategist with feather fan, chained warships behind.

valve_text: Call of the Wild: Summon a Loyal Beast.
zh_text: 巧造木兽：召唤一头木兽。主动技能，冷却3。
en_text: Clockwork Beast: summon a Wooden Beast. Active ability; cooldown 3.
rationale: In 演义 ch.90 Shu routs King Mulu's beast army with fire-breathing wooden beasts, a device folk tradition credits to the inventor Huang Yueying. Summoning a war beast and scattering the enemy line is Beastmaster's kit.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/huangyueying.png: Huang Yueying, inventor in crimson robes beside a carved wooden war-beast.

valve_text: Barroom Brawler: Modify Bristleback with +2 Armor after a hero blocking it dies.
zh_text: 定军山：阻挡黄忠的武将阵亡后，永久使黄忠+2护甲。
en_text: Dingjun Mountain: permanently give Huang Zhong +2 armor after a hero blocking him dies.
rationale: At Dingjun Mountain Huang Zhong cut down the enemy general Xiahou Yuan, so he hardens after killing a hero. 烈弓 (his 三国杀 skill) is the armor-shredding signature arrow. Avoids the mapped 老当益壮.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/huangzhong.png: Huang Zhong, white-bearded archer drawing a great bow on a mountain slope.

valve_text: Nether Blast: Condemn a random enemy improvement.
zh_text: 看破：处斩一个随机的敌方营建。主动技能，冷却3。
en_text: See Through: condemn a random enemy improvement. Active ability; cooldown 3.
rationale: Zhuge Liang is the counter-strategist: 看破 (his 三国杀 skill) sees through and dismantles an enemy work, and his signature 将计就计 turns every enemy scheme back on the schemer. Avoids the reserved 八阵图 / 空城计 / 草船借箭, the mapped 东风, and 火烧博望 (now the red Raze card).
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/zhugeliang.png: Zhuge Liang with feather fan and silk cap before a glowing altar and burning valley.

valve_text: (no ability)
zh_text: 孙尚香没有主动或被动技能。
en_text: Sun Shangxiang has no active or passive ability.
rationale: Faction move Wu to Shu. As Liu Bei's wife she lived in his household at Gong'an, and the SP 孙尚香 in 三国杀 is Shu. The armed, armoured lady (her maids carried blades) suits a 6/3/6 heavy-armour vanilla hero. 孙夫人城 at Gong'an is the tower-armor signature.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/sunshangxiang.png: Sun Shangxiang in armour with bow and blades. Regenerate with the Shu faction line: the current portrait uses the Wu palette.

valve_text: Great Cleave: Sven has +X Cleave where X is equal to half its Attack.
zh_text: 双股剑：刘备+X横扫，X为其攻击的一半。
en_text: Twin Swords: Liu Bei has +X cleave, where X is half his attack.
rationale: Liu Bei's paired swords (双股剑) sweep both sides. 髀肉之叹, his lament that idleness had fattened his thighs, is the return to war that permanently powers up a red hero. Avoids the reserved 桃园结义 (red's 8-mana spell) and 三顾茅庐.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/liubei.png: Liu Bei, benevolent lord with twin swords under red silk banners.

valve_text: Moment of Courage: Legion Commander has +2 Retaliate.
zh_text: 神威：马超+2反击。
en_text: Divine Might: Ma Chao has +2 retaliate.
rationale: Ma Chao, hailed in 演义 as the 'Divine Might General' (神威天将军), punishes every attacker. His torch-lit night duel with Zhang Fei at Jiameng Pass is the most famous one-on-one fight in the novel, so it is his Duel signature.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/machao.png: Ma Chao in silver lion-helm armour, spear levelled, torch-lit pass behind.

valve_text: Fury Swipes: When Ursa deals battle damage to a unit, modify that unit with -1 Armor.
zh_text: 狂骨：魏延对一个单位造成战斗伤害时，永久使该单位-1护甲。
en_text: Reckless Fury: when Wei Yan deals battle damage to a unit, permanently give that unit -1 armor.
rationale: Wei Yan is a ferocious, relentless brawler (三国杀 狂骨), and each blow strips more armour. His boast on taking command of Hanzhong, that he would hold it against Cao Cao's whole realm, is the +4/+4 signature.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/weiyan.png: Wei Yan, fierce red-faced general with a heavy blade in a battle stance.

valve_text: Venomous Nature: Summon a Plague Ward into Venomancer's lane each deployment phase.
zh_text: 屯田：每个部署阶段，召唤一名屯田兵至邓艾所在路。
en_text: Military Farms: summon a Farm Soldier into Deng Ai's lane each deployment phase.
rationale: Deng Ai founded the Huai river military-farm colonies (三国杀 skill 屯田). Steady free troops every round fit Venomancer's ward-per-deployment passive. Signature 屯兵淮南 summons two more Farm Soldiers.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/dengai.png: Deng Ai, Wei general-engineer, among irrigated military-farm fields with a spear.

valve_text: Poof: Move Meepo to an allied Meepo's lane. Deal 2 damage to the new enemy neighbors. / United We Fall: Meepo has Soulbound. (If Meepo dies, other allied Meepos in every lane also die.)
ability_zh: 神速（主动2）；同气连枝（被动）
zh_text:
神速：将夏侯渊移至另一名友方夏侯渊所在路，并对新的敌方邻位单位造成2点伤害。主动技能，冷却2。
同气连枝：夏侯渊具有同命（夏侯渊阵亡时，所有路中的其他友方夏侯渊也随之阵亡）。
en_text:
Lightning March: move Xiahou Yuan to an allied Xiahou Yuan's lane. Deal 2 damage to the new enemy neighbors. Active ability; cooldown 2.
One Root: Xiahou Yuan has Soulbound. (If Xiahou Yuan dies, other allied Xiahou Yuans in every lane also die.)
rationale: Wei said of Xiahou Yuan's speed '三日五百，六日一千', and 三国杀 gives him 神速. A hero who jumps to wherever his copies are suits a general who seemed to be on every front at once. Signature 分兵疾进 summons another Xiahou Yuan.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/xiahouyuan.png: Xiahou Yuan, Wei cavalry general, mid-gallop with bow and banner.

valve_text: Lucent Beam: Before the action phase, deal 1 piercing damage to a random enemy and add a charge to three random Eclipse cards in your hand or deck.
zh_text: 倾国：行动阶段前，对随机一个敌方单位造成1点穿透伤害，并为你手牌或牌组中随机三张《洛神赋》各增加1层充能。
en_text: Captivating Beauty: before the action phase, deal 1 piercing damage to a random enemy and add a charge to three random Ode to the Luo Goddess cards in your hand or deck.
rationale: Luna is a moon caster. Zhen Ji is tied by legend to Cao Zhi's Ode to the Luo River Goddess (三国杀 skills 倾国 / 洛神), so the beam that charges the 'Ode' carries her legend.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/zhenji.png: Zhen Ji, Wei noblewoman, silk sleeves flowing over moonlit water.

valve_text: Bringer of Conquest: The random allied Melee Creeps are deployed into Kanna's lane.
zh_text: 王佐之才：随机部署的友方步卒改为部署至荀彧所在路。
en_text: Kingmaker's Talent: allied Foot Soldiers deployed at random are deployed into Xun Yu's lane instead.
rationale: He Yong judged the young Xun Yu 'a talent to aid a king' (王佐才也), and he gathered men and supplies for Cao Cao's cause, which fits troops flocking to his lane. 驱虎吞狼 is his stratagem in 演义 ch.14, and summoning predators onto wounded units is that plan in action.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/xunyu.png: Xun Yu, elegant Wei minister in indigo court robes holding a memorial.

valve_text: Fissure: Stun Earthshaker's enemy neighbors this round.
zh_text: 突袭：本回合眩晕张辽的敌方邻位单位。主动技能，冷却4。
en_text: Sudden Raid: stun Zhang Liao's enemy neighbors this round. Active ability; cooldown 4.
rationale: Zhang Liao's shock raids stun the line (三国杀 突袭). His name alone hushed crying children in Wu (辽来止啼), so the more enemies there are, the further the terror spreads. Avoids the mapped 威震逍遥津.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/zhangliao.png: Zhang Liao charging at the head of cavalry, glaive raised, steel-blue banners.

valve_text: Multicast: After you play a blue spell, there is a 25% chance to put a base copy of that card into your hand.
zh_text: 天妒：你施放一张蓝色计策后，有25%几率将该牌的基础副本置入你的手牌。
en_text: Heaven's Envy: after you play a blue spell, there is a 25% chance to put a base copy of that card into your hand.
rationale: Guo Jia's 三国杀 skill 天妒 keeps the card that was drawn against him, which maps onto free copies of spells. His 'ten victories, ten defeats' analysis of Yuan Shao is a lasting edge that grinds the enemy down every round. Only the event name 遗计 is used by a mapped card.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/guojia.png: Guo Jia, pale brilliant advisor with wine gourd and scroll under cold moonlight.

valve_text: Essence Aura: After you play a blue card, there is a 50% chance to restore 2 Mana.
zh_text: 明策：你打出一张蓝色牌后，有50%几率恢复2点军令。
en_text: Clear Counsel: after you play a blue card, there is a 50% chance to restore 2 mana.
rationale: Faction move Qun to Wei. Chen Gong was Cao Cao's first strategist and won him Yanzhou in 192; in 演义 he frees the captured Cao Cao, so 捉放曹 (seize, then spare) is Astral Imprisonment. 明策 is his 三国杀 skill.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/chengong.png: Chen Gong, stern strategist in scholar robes. Regenerate with the Wei faction line: the current portrait uses the Qun palette.

valve_text: Bringer of the Faithful: Summon a Melee Creep into Prellex's lane each deployment phase.
zh_text: 乡勇：每个部署阶段，召唤一名步卒至许褚所在路。
en_text: Clan Militia: summon a Foot Soldier into Xu Chu's lane each deployment phase.
rationale: Xu Chu raised a clan militia of thousands to hold his walled village against the Yellow Turbans, then led Cao Cao's Tiger Guard (虎卫). A steady stream of Foot Soldiers and a barracks signature fit both.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/xuchu.png: Xu Chu, bare-chested giant with a great blade before ranks of guards.

valve_text: Concussive Shot: Give a hero and its allied neighbors -2 Armor this round.
zh_text: 强袭：本回合使一名武将及其友方邻位单位-2护甲。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text: Fierce Assault: give a hero and its allied neighbors -2 armor this round. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: At Puyang Dian Wei hurled armfuls of short halberds into the closing enemy, splitting damage across a group (the signature). 强袭 is his 三国杀 skill. His death at Wancheng (the mapped 宛城之变) is avoided.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/dianwei.png: Dian Wei, massive bodyguard with twin iron halberds, short halberds in his belt.

valve_text: Arcane Aura: After the first time an allied spell is played in each lane, restore 2 Mana to the tower in that lane.
zh_text: 清俭：每一路中首次打出友方计策后，为该路的城楼恢复2点军令。
en_text: Frugal Steward: after the first time an allied spell is played in each lane, restore 2 mana to the tower in that lane.
rationale: 三国志 calls Xiahou Dun 性清俭: he gave away his surplus wealth and built dams as a governor, which suits a mana-refund support (三国杀 清俭). When an arrow took his eye he pulled it out and ate it, a sight that leaves the enemy too shaken to strike (the disarm signature).
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/xiahoudun.png: Xiahou Dun, one-eyed Wei general with eyepatch and spear in cold moonlight.

valve_text: Borrowed Time: Fully heal Abaddon and give it Damage Immunity this round.
zh_text: 不屈：完全恢复周泰的体力，本回合周泰免疫伤害。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text: Unbowed: fully heal Zhou Tai and give him damage immunity this round. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: Zhou Tai shielded Sun Quan at Xuancheng and survived a dozen wounds (三国杀 不屈). A full self-heal with immunity, plus a shield spell for an ally, is his story.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/zhoutai.png: Zhou Tai, scarred Wu bodyguard, standing firm with a raised blade.

valve_text: Holy Persuasion: Get control of an enemy creep.
zh_text: 缔盟：获得一名敌方兵卒的控制权。主动技能，冷却4。
en_text: Forge Alliance: get control of an enemy creep. Active ability; cooldown 4.
rationale: Lu Su is Wu's diplomat (三国杀 缔盟): he wins enemy troops over by persuasion, not force. He gave Zhou Yu a whole granary (指囷相赠), which fits the army-wide full heal of his signature.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/lusu.png: Lu Su, Wu statesman in scholar robes, offering an open hand.

valve_text: Corrosive Skin: When a unit deals battle damage to Viper, modify that unit with -1 Attack.
zh_text: 铁鞭：一个单位对黄盖造成战斗伤害时，永久使该单位-1攻击。
en_text: Iron Whip: when a unit deals battle damage to Huang Gai, permanently give that unit -1 attack.
rationale: The veteran's iron whip (his weapon in 演义) wears down every attacker. His fake-surrender fire ships kept Cao's fleet burning, so the damage-over-time signature is his. Avoids the reserved 苦肉计 and 火烧赤壁.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/huanggai.png: Huang Gai, grizzled Wu veteran with iron whip on a burning ship's prow.

valve_text: Nature's Attendants: Enchantress has +2 Regeneration. Enchantress's allied neighbors have +2 Regeneration.
zh_text: 国色：大乔+2再生。大乔的友方邻位单位+2再生。
en_text: Peerless Grace: Da Qiao has +2 regeneration. Da Qiao's allied neighbors have +2 regeneration.
rationale: Da Qiao is a gentle support beauty (三国杀 国色) whose presence restores the allies beside her. The sisters' family home becomes the protective sanctuary signature.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/daqiao.png: Da Qiao in jade-green silks by a misty riverside pavilion.

valve_text: Purification: Heal a unit 3.
zh_text: 天香：为一个单位恢复3点体力。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text: Heavenly Fragrance: heal a unit 3. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: Xiao Qiao is the healer counterpart of her sister (三国杀 天香). Her harmony with Zhou Yu, the commander who loved music, becomes the army-wide regeneration blessing.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/xiaoqiao.png: Xiao Qiao with a guqin among reeds and river mist (attach Da Qiao for likeness).

valve_text: Branches of Iron: Treant Protector's allied neighbors have +2 Armor.
zh_text: 坚守：陆逊的友方邻位单位+2护甲。
en_text: Hold the Line: Lu Xun's allied neighbors have +2 armor.
rationale: At Yiling Lu Xun held his defensive line for months before striking, so he protects his neighbors. The Lu were one of Wu's four great clans, and their retainers feed the war chest (the mana creep signature).
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/luxun.png: Lu Xun, young scholar-general calmly holding a sword before river fortifications.

valve_text: (no ability)
zh_text: 孙策没有主动或被动技能。
en_text: Sun Ce has no active or passive ability.
rationale: The 'Little Conqueror' is a plain, sturdy 4/1/9 frontliner whose power lies in inspiring others. 激昂 (his 三国杀 skill) is the permanent attack-and-cleave signature he passes to a unit.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/sunce.png: Sun Ce, young conqueror with spear raised, rallying Wu troops by the river.

valve_text: Surge: Move another ally to another lane.
zh_text: 突围请援：将另一个友方单位移至另一路。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text: Break Out for Aid: move another ally to another lane. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: Taishi Ci rode out through the siege of Beihai to bring Liu Bei's relief army, which fits moving an ally into another lane. His evenly matched duel with Sun Ce at Shenting is the strike-back signature.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/taishici.png: Taishi Ci, archer-cavalryman with twin halberds breaking through a siege line.

valve_text: Arctic Burn: Move Winter Wyvern to an empty combat position and give it +4 Attack this round.
zh_text: 闭月：将貂蝉移至一个空的交战位置，本回合貂蝉+4攻击。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text: Moon-Shy Beauty: move Diaochan to an empty combat position and give her +4 attack this round. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: Winter's Curse makes a unit's own allies attack it, which is Diaochan setting Lü Bu against Dong Zhuo (三国杀 离间). 闭月 (her 'moon hides its face' epithet) becomes the slip-into-position strike.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/diaochan.png: Diaochan in dark silks under a veiled moon, a fan half-hiding her face.

valve_text: Blood Bath: Fully heal Bloodseeker after a unit blocking it dies.
zh_text: 暴虐：阻挡董卓的单位阵亡后，完全恢复董卓的体力。
en_text: Tyranny: fully heal Dong Zhuo after a unit blocking him dies.
rationale: A bloodthirsty brute who feeds on kills fits the tyrant (三国杀 暴虐 / 酒池 / 肉林). A drunk, silenced berserker is his signature 酒池肉林.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/dongzhuo.png: Dong Zhuo, bloated tyrant in black-and-gold armour, goblet in hand amid smoke.

valve_text: Jinada: Before the action phase, there is a 50% chance to give Bounty Hunter +4 Attack this round.
zh_text: 乱击：行动阶段前，有50%几率使袁绍本回合+4攻击。
en_text: Wild Volley: before the action phase, there is a 50% chance to give Yuan Shao +4 attack this round.
rationale: Yuan Shao was rich and indecisive, so a coin-flip attack boost suits him; 乱击 (random arrow volleys) is his 三国杀 skill. Chen Lin's proclamation for him put a price on Cao Cao's head, which is the bounty signature.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/yuanshao.png: Yuan Shao, aristocratic warlord in gilded armour before massed banners.

valve_text: Laser: Deal 3 damage to a unit and disarm it this round.
zh_text: 雷击：对一个单位造成3点伤害，并在本回合使其缴械。主动技能，冷却3。
en_text: Heaven's Thunder: deal 3 damage to a unit and disarm it this round. Active ability; cooldown 3.
rationale: Zhang Jiao is the Yellow Turban sorcerer who calls down lightning (三国杀 雷击). Charge-by-charge uprising waves that hit every enemy and the tower suit his slogan 苍天已死，黄天当立.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/zhangjiao.png: Zhang Jiao in yellow Daoist robes, staff raised as lightning splits a stormy sky.

valve_text: Sacrifice: Condemn another ally and draw a card. If that ally has 6 or more Attack, draw an extra card.
zh_text: 祭旗：处斩另一个友方单位并摸一张牌。若该单位攻击不低于6，额外摸一张牌。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text: Blood the Banner: condemn another ally and draw a card. If that ally has 6 or more attack, draw an extra card. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: The Nanman king spends his tribes freely before battle (祭旗). He was captured and freed seven times and came back every time, which is the seven-times-repeating Chain Frost signature 七擒七纵.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/menghuo.png: Meng Huo, Nanman king in hide and bronze, war-paint, jungle mist behind.

valve_text: Headshot: Deal 5 damage to a unit.
zh_text: 飞刀：对一个单位造成5点伤害。主动技能，冷却3。
en_text: Flying Knives: deal 5 damage to a unit. Active ability; cooldown 3.
rationale: In 演义 ch.89 Lady Zhurong fights with thrown flying knives, the ranged burst of a sniper. She claims descent from the fire god Zhurong, which names the any-lane execution signature.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/zhurong.png: Lady Zhurong mid-throw, flying knives fanned in her hand, embers swirling.

valve_text: Warmonger: Sorla Khan deals +4 damage when attacking a tower.
zh_text: 破虏：孙坚攻击城楼时，额外造成4点伤害。
en_text: Raider's Bane: Sun Jian deals +4 damage when attacking a tower.
rationale: Faction move Wu to Qun. Sun Jian died in 191, before Wu existed, as a coalition warlord under Yuan Shu against Dong Zhuo, and was first into Luoyang, so he is the tower-breaker. 破虏 is from his title 破虏将军. Avoids the mapped 江东猛虎.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/sunjian.png: Sun Jian with red headscarf storming a city gate. Regenerate with the Qun faction line: the current portrait uses the Wu palette.

valve_text: Sadist: Modify Necrophos with +1 Health after an enemy neighbor dies.
zh_text: 五禽戏：一个敌方邻位单位阵亡后，永久使华佗+1体力。
en_text: Five Animals Play: permanently give Hua Tuo +1 health after an enemy neighbor dies.
rationale: Necrophos is a plague doctor and Hua Tuo the legendary physician. His 五禽戏 exercises build his vitality, and his 麻沸散 anaesthetic numbs every enemy beside the hero. Avoids the mapped 刮骨疗毒.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/huatuo.png: Hua Tuo, elderly physician with herb satchel and smoking medicine bowl.

valve_text: Finger of Death: Deal 8 piercing damage to a unit. Quicken (reduce cooldown by 1, but not below 1).
zh_text: 遁甲天书：对一个单位造成8点穿透伤害。加速（冷却减少1，但不低于1）。主动技能，冷却4。
en_text: Dunjia Scripture: deal 8 piercing damage to a unit. Quicken (reduce cooldown by 1, but not below 1). Active ability; cooldown 4.
rationale: Zuo Ci, the Daoist magician who received the 遁甲天书 in 演义 ch.68, casts the big piercing spell. In the same chapter he mocks Cao Cao at his own feast (掷杯戏曹), so his signature steals the enemy's resources.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/zuoci.png: Zuo Ci, one-eyed Daoist immortal with a glowing scripture and a dove taking flight.

valve_text: Overload: Give Storm Spirit +2 Attack until end of its next combat phase after you play a black card in any lane.
zh_text: 攻无不破：你在任意路中打出一张黑色牌后，使高顺+2攻击，直至其下一个交战阶段结束。
en_text: Never Repelled: after you play a black card in any lane, give Gao Shun +2 attack until the end of his next combat phase.
rationale: 英雄记 says Gao Shun's unit 'broke every position it attacked' (所攻无不破). His 198 strike that took Xiaopei from Liu Bei is the any-lane hero reposition signature. Avoids the mapped 陷阵营.
art_subject: Existing portrait assets/art/heroes_reserve/gaoshun.png: Gao Shun, stern disciplined commander in black lamellar at the head of armoured shock troops.

valve_text:
Modify a red hero with +1 Armor. 
 Get initiative.
zh_text: 永久使一名红色武将+1护甲。获得先手。
en_text: Permanently give a red hero +1 armor. Get initiative.
rationale: Pang Tong's signature. Sent to Leiyang as a minor magistrate, he cleared a hundred days of cases in half a day (演义 ch.57): a cheap card that seizes the initiative and leaves a small lasting gain.
art_subject: Pang Tong lounging at a magistrate's bench, wine cup in one hand and brush in the other, as clerks rush stacks of bamboo case-files past and petitioners bow.

valve_text: Give a red hero +8 Attack and -8 Armor this round.
zh_text: 本回合使一名红色武将+8攻击、-8护甲。
en_text: Give a red hero +8 attack and -8 armor this round.
rationale: Jiang Wei's signature. He marched north against Wei again and again, pouring everything into attack and leaving Shu's defences thin: +8 attack for -8 armor is that all-or-nothing gamble.
art_subject: Jiang Wei leading a thin crimson column at full charge down a snowy mountain road toward Wei fortresses, his own camp left almost empty behind him.

valve_text: Give a red hero +4 Attack this round.
zh_text: 本回合使一名红色武将+4攻击。
en_text: Give a red hero +4 attack this round.
rationale: The novel's famous trick of feigning retreat with the blade trailing, then wheeling for a sudden killing cut: a cheap one-round burst of attack.
art_subject: A Shu cavalry general turned backward in the saddle mid-gallop, a long blade dragging low behind him and about to swing up at a pursuing rider.

valve_text: Choose an ally. Choose a combat target for it.
zh_text: 选择一个友方单位，为其指定交战目标。
en_text: Choose an ally. Choose a combat target for it.
rationale: Zhang Song secretly gave Liu Bei a map of Yi Province's roads and garrisons, showing exactly where to strike: a cheap card that chooses an ally's target.
art_subject: A small, sharp-eyed official unrolling a painted map of mountain roads and fortresses before a candlelit table as Shu officers lean in to study it.

valve_text:
Give a red hero +2 Armor this round. 
 Get initiative.
zh_text: 本回合使一名红色武将+2护甲。获得先手。
en_text: Give a red hero +2 armor this round. Get initiative.
rationale: At Yiling Fu Tong held the rear so Liu Bei could escape and refused to surrender to the end: a one-round armor surge that buys the tempo.
art_subject: A lone wounded Shu officer standing his ground on a burning road, spear held across a narrow path as fleeing red banners vanish into the smoke behind him.

valve_text: Choose an allied red hero. Deal 2 damage to its enemy neighbors and give them -2 Attack this round.
zh_text: 选择一名友方红色武将，对其敌方邻位单位造成2点伤害，并使它们本回合-2攻击。
en_text: Choose an allied red hero. Deal 2 damage to its enemy neighbors and give them -2 attack this round.
rationale: Zhao Yun's signature. At Changban he rode in and out of Cao Cao's army again and again (七进七出 in the novel), wounding and blunting everyone around him. 单骑救主 stays reserved.
art_subject: Zhao Yun in silver-white armour, the swaddled infant at his chest, carving a path through a dense press of enemy spearmen with sweeping strokes of his silver spear.

valve_text: Modify a red hero with "After you play a non-item card costing 2 or less, modify this hero with +2 Health."
zh_text: 永久使一名红色武将获得：“你打出费用不高于2的非军备卡牌后，永久使此武将+2体力。”
en_text: Permanently give a red hero "After you play a non-item card costing 2 or less, permanently give this hero +2 health."
rationale: Liao Hua served Shu from its founding to its fall ('蜀中无大将，廖化作先锋'): a veteran who outlasted everyone, so he grows tougher with every small card.
art_subject: The grizzled veteran Liao Hua, scarred and grey-bearded in battered crimson armour, planting a spear at the head of a thinning column as younger soldiers rally behind him.

valve_text: Choose an allied red hero and another unit. They battle each other.
zh_text: 选择一名友方红色武将与另一个单位，令二者相互交锋。
en_text: Choose an allied red hero and another unit. They battle each other.
rationale: Ma Chao's signature. At Jiameng Pass he fought Zhang Fei all day and on into the night by torchlight (演义 ch.65), the novel's most famous one-on-one duel.
art_subject: Ma Chao in his silver lion helm clashing spear against spear with a black-bearded giant by torchlight before a mountain pass gate, rows of soldiers holding torches on both sides.

valve_text: Choose an allied hero. It taunts. Choose a combat target for it.
zh_text: 选择一名友方武将，使其嘲讽，并为其指定交战目标。
en_text: Choose an allied hero. It taunts. Choose a combat target for it.
rationale: Before the armies in 演义 ch.93, Zhuge Liang taunts the Wei minister Wang Lang so savagely that he falls dead from his horse: the purest taunt in the novel, and it picks the hero's target.
art_subject: Two armies facing off across a plain while a feather-fanned strategist on a small cart points scornfully at an old Wei minister who reels and topples from his horse.

valve_text: Modify a red hero with "After you play a non-item card costing 2 or less, modify this hero with +1 Attack."
zh_text: 永久使一名红色武将获得：“你打出费用不高于2的非军备卡牌后，永久使此武将+1攻击。”
en_text: Permanently give a red hero "After you play a non-item card costing 2 or less, permanently give this hero +1 attack."
rationale: Guan Xing and Zhang Bao, sons of the fallen sworn brothers, grew fiercer battle by battle as they avenged their fathers: attack that keeps building.
art_subject: Two young Shu warriors, one with a green-tasselled glaive and one with a serpent spear, charging shoulder to shoulder beneath fluttering white mourning ribbons.

valve_text: Condemn an improvement. Draw a card.
zh_text: 处斩一个营建。摸一张牌。
en_text: Condemn an improvement. Draw a card.
rationale: Zhang Fei took Zhang He's fortified position at Wakou Pass with a feint and a hidden mountain path (演义 ch.70): one fortification falls, and the scouting draws a card.
art_subject: Shu soldiers in red scrambling over a mountain pass and pulling down a burning wooden gate-fort, a hidden goat path winding up the cliff behind them.

valve_text: Give a hero and its allied neighbors Pierce this round. Draw a card.
zh_text: 本回合使一名武将及其友方邻位单位获得穿透。摸一张牌。
en_text: Give a hero and its allied neighbors pierce this round. Draw a card.
rationale: At Mount Dingjun the advisor Fa Zheng watched for the moment the enemy tired and gave the signal to attack. Seeing the gap lets a whole group ignore armor, and the insight draws a card.
art_subject: The strategist Fa Zheng on a hilltop raising a plain red signal banner, while below a line of Shu soldiers surges through a gap in a tired enemy formation.

valve_text: Modify a unit with -X Armor where X is its Armor.
zh_text: 永久使一个单位-X护甲，X为其护甲值。
en_text: Permanently give a unit -X armor, where X is its armor.
rationale: In Coiled Serpent Valley (演义 ch.90) Zhuge Liang turned the oil-soaked rattan armour of Wutugu's army into their doom: armor reduced to nothing.
art_subject: A winding serpent-shaped jungle valley seen from the ridge, fire racing along its floor and warriors in glistening woven armour caught in the flames below.

valve_text: Give a red hero +4 Attack and +4 Armor this round.
zh_text: 本回合使一名红色武将+4攻击、+4护甲。
en_text: Give a red hero +4 attack and +4 armor this round.
rationale: Wei Yan's signature. Given command of Hanzhong, he vowed to hold it against Cao Cao's whole realm: a short, all-out surge of strength and defence (+4/+4 this round).
art_subject: Wei Yan with his heavy blade planted on a mountain-pass wall, red banners snapping behind him, staring down an enormous Wei host filling the valley.

valve_text: Give allied heroes +4 Cleave this round.
zh_text: 本回合使所有友方武将+4横扫。
en_text: Give allied heroes +4 cleave this round.
rationale: Shu's Five Tiger Generals each swept through enemy ranks. A team-wide burst of cleave honours all five at once without spending any one of them.
art_subject: Five Shu generals charging side by side in a wedge, glaive, serpent spear, silver spear, lion-helm spear and bow, sweeping a wide arc through a scattering enemy line.

valve_text: Stun a unit blocking an allied red hero this round. Deal 2 damage to that unit.
zh_text: 本回合眩晕一个阻挡友方红色武将的单位，并对其造成2点伤害。
en_text: Stun a unit blocking an allied red hero this round. Deal 2 damage to that unit.
rationale: The famous 'turnback spear': feign flight, then twist in the saddle and stab the pursuer, who is caught stunned. A classic Shu cavalry trick.
art_subject: A Shu spearman twisting backward on a galloping horse, his spear thrusting behind him into a startled pursuing rider who reels in the saddle.

valve_text: Modify a red hero with "After you play a red card, give this hero and its allied neighbors +1 Attack and +1 Armor this round."
zh_text: 永久使一名红色武将获得：“你打出红色牌后，本回合使此武将及其友方邻位单位+1攻击、+1护甲。”
en_text: Permanently give a red hero "After you play a red card, give this hero and its allied neighbors +1 attack and +1 armor this round."
rationale: Shu's rallying cause from the Chu Shi Biao: every red card answers the call to restore the Han, lifting the hero and the troops beside him.
art_subject: A Shu general raising a great plain crimson war standard on a hill at sunrise while ranks of soldiers around him lift their weapons in answer.

valve_text: Modify a unit with -2 Armor.
zh_text: 永久使一个单位-2护甲。
en_text: Permanently give a unit -2 armor.
rationale: Huang Zhong's signature. 烈弓 is his 三国杀 skill: arrows from the old general's great bow punch through armour for good (-2 armor, permanent).
art_subject: The white-bearded Huang Zhong at full draw on a mountain slope, a heavy arrow already punching through an enemy's lamellar breastplate in a spray of broken plates.

valve_text: Modify a hero with -2 Attack.
zh_text: 永久使一名武将-2攻击。
en_text: Permanently give a hero -2 attack.
rationale: Ma Su's advice for the Southern Campaign, recorded in 襄阳记: 'attacking the heart is superior to attacking cities'. Breaking a hero's will permanently blunts his attack.
art_subject: A defeated, unbound tribal chieftain on his knees before a Shu camp, sword lowered to the ground and head bowed, as an open-handed strategist gestures to let him go.

valve_text: Condemn all enemy improvements.
zh_text: 处斩所有敌方营建。
en_text: Condemn all enemy improvements.
rationale: Zhuge Liang's first battle in 演义 ch.39: he lured Xiahou Dun into Bowang Slope and set the reeds and camp ablaze. Burning every enemy fortification at once is the high-cost wipe of improvements.
art_subject: A narrow reed-filled valley at dusk erupting into a wall of flame, enemy palisades, tents and supply wagons burning as fire arrows streak down from the dark ridges.

valve_text: Proceed to the combat phase.
zh_text: 立即进入交战阶段。
en_text: Proceed to the combat phase.
rationale: In 演义 ch.5 Guan Yu rides out and returns with Hua Xiong's head before his cup of warm wine has cooled: no more talk, straight to the fight.
art_subject: A cup of steaming wine on a lacquered war-council table in the foreground, while beyond the open tent flap a crimson-robed rider with a long glaive gallops back through the camp gate.

valve_text: Modify enemy heroes at the Fountain with -X Attack where X is half their Attack. Modify them with "Your tower has -1 Mana."
zh_text: 永久使大营中的敌方武将-X攻击，X为其攻击的一半。并永久使它们获得：“你的城楼-1军令。”
en_text: Permanently give enemy heroes at the Fountain -X attack, where X is half their attack. Permanently give them "Your tower has -1 mana."
rationale: Hanzhong, 219: stalled by Liu Bei, Cao Cao gave the night password 'chicken rib' (鸡肋), worthless to keep yet a pity to throw away, and his officers began packing to retreat. Heroes resting in camp lose heart and drain their own side.
art_subject: A dim Wei command tent at night, a bowl of bare chicken ribs on the table, weary officers quietly rolling up maps and tents while Shu red banners crowd the mountains outside.

valve_text: Modify a red hero with +4 Attack.
zh_text: 永久使一名红色武将+4攻击。
en_text: Permanently give a red hero +4 attack.
rationale: Liu Bei's signature. Idle at Liu Biao's court, he wept that his thighs had grown fat from years out of the saddle; his return to war permanently powers up a red hero.
art_subject: Liu Bei rising from a banquet seat in Jingzhou, tears on his face, gripping his twin swords as he looks out at a red-bannered army forming in the courtyard.

valve_text: Stun a unit blocking an allied red hero this round. Move that unit's allied neighbors to random other lanes.
zh_text: 本回合眩晕一个阻挡友方红色武将的单位，并将该单位的友方邻位单位随机移至其他路。
en_text: Stun a unit blocking an allied red hero this round. Move that unit's allied neighbors to random other lanes.
rationale: Huang Yueying's signature. In 演义 ch.90 fire-breathing wooden beasts rout King Mulu's beast army: the front rank is stunned and the troops beside it scatter.
art_subject: Huang Yueying directing two carved wooden war-beasts that breathe fire and smoke, enemy war elephants and tigers fleeing in panic through the jungle.

valve_text: Summon two Centaur Hunters into any lane.
zh_text: 在任意一路中召唤两支无当飞军。
en_text: Summon two Wudang Flying Army into any lane.
rationale: Wang Ping's Wudang Flying Army (the mapped Centaur Hunter), light mountain troops from the south, appear wherever they are needed: two of them into any lane.
art_subject: Light-armoured southern mountain troops in red leaping down a misty cliff path and bursting out of the forest onto a startled enemy flank, war drums on the slope behind.

valve_text: Modify allied heroes with +4 Attack, +4 Armor, +4 Health, +4 Cleave, +4 Retaliate, and +4 Siege.
zh_text: 永久使所有友方武将+4攻击、+4护甲、+4体力、+4横扫、+4反击、+4攻城。
en_text: Permanently give allied heroes +4 attack, +4 armor, +4 health, +4 cleave, +4 retaliate and +4 siege.
rationale: The reserved set piece goes on red's most expensive spell (8 mana): the oath of brotherhood that founded Shu makes every allied hero stronger in every way, permanently.
art_subject: Three sworn brothers kneeling before an incense altar beneath blossoming peach trees, cups raised together as pink petals swirl in warm golden light.

valve_text: Deal 2 damage to each enemy creep.
zh_text: 对每个敌方兵卒造成2点伤害。
en_text: Deal 2 damage to each enemy creep.
rationale: Cao Cao's elite Tiger and Leopard Cavalry rode down infantry formations: a cheap sweep that hits every enemy creep but no heroes.
art_subject: Armoured Wei heavy cavalry with tiger-pattern barding sweeping through a line of panicked enemy foot soldiers across a dusty plain.

valve_text: Draw 2 cards. Deal 2 damage to allies in all lanes.
zh_text: 摸两张牌。对所有路中的友方单位造成2点伤害。
en_text: Draw 2 cards. Deal 2 damage to allies in all lanes.
rationale: When his horse trampled the crops he had forbidden anyone to touch, Cao Cao cut off his hair in place of his head: self-punishment that tightened discipline. Cards paid for by hurting your own side.
art_subject: A stern Wei lord slicing off his topknot with a sword before kneeling ranks of soldiers in a trampled wheat field under a grey sky.

valve_text: Choose a unit. It taunts.
zh_text: 选择一个单位，使其嘲讽。
en_text: Choose a unit. It taunts.
rationale: Goading a general into rash action (激将法) recurs throughout the novel: force a unit to taunt and draw the enemy's blows where you want them.
art_subject: A Wei herald on horseback shouting insults up at an enraged enemy general on a city wall, who grips his weapon ready to charge out.

valve_text: Swap a unit with one of its allied neighbors. Draw a card.
zh_text: 将一个单位与其一个友方邻位单位交换位置。摸一张牌。
en_text: Swap a unit with one of its allied neighbors. Draw a card.
rationale: Chased by Ma Chao at Tong Pass, Cao Cao cut his beard and threw off his red robe so the pursuers lost him among his own men (演义 ch.58): swap places with an ally and slip away.
art_subject: A hunted Wei lord slashing off his beard with a dagger while discarding a red robe, galloping among his own riders through a dusty pass.

valve_text: Stun an enemy this round and stun allied heroes in all lanes this round.
zh_text: 本回合眩晕一个敌方单位，并眩晕所有路中的友方武将。
en_text: Stun an enemy this round and stun allied heroes in all lanes this round.
rationale: Cao Cao claimed he killed people in his sleep and executed an attendant who covered him (演义 ch.72); afterwards no one dared approach. Stunning a foe also freezes your own heroes.
art_subject: A Wei lord half-risen from a dark bed with a sword in hand, nightmare shadows coiling around him while terrified attendants freeze in the doorway.

valve_text: Deal 2 damage to all towers in all lanes.
zh_text: 对所有路中的所有城楼造成2点伤害。
en_text: Deal 2 damage to all towers in all lanes.
rationale: As Cao Cao and Liu Bei discussed heroes over green-plum wine, a thunderclap shook them both (演义 ch.21). A storm that hits every tower on both sides fits that shared jolt.
art_subject: Two lords at a pavilion table with a wine kettle and green plums as a jagged bolt of lightning splits the stormy sky above distant city walls.

valve_text: Deal 2 damage to a unit and disarm it this round.
zh_text: 对一个单位造成2点伤害，并使其本回合缴械。
en_text: Deal 2 damage to a unit and disarm it this round.
rationale: Xiahou Dun's signature. Struck in the eye by an arrow, he pulled it out and ate the eye (演义 ch.18); the enemy archer was too stunned to fight back.
art_subject: Xiahou Dun on horseback wrenching an arrow from his bloodied eye while the enemy archer before him drops his bow in horror.

valve_text: Spend all your gold. Repeat one time for each gold spent: Deal 4 damage to a random ally or enemy.
zh_text: 花费你所有的金。每花费1金，重复一次：对一个随机友方或敌方单位造成4点伤害。
en_text: Spend all your gold. Repeat once for each gold spent: deal 4 damage to a random ally or enemy.
rationale: Warlords of the era posted huge bounties for heads, and hired blades struck at anyone in reach. Pouring all your gold into random bloodshed on both sides is that reckless price.
art_subject: A chest of gold coins spilling across a war table as shadowy hired blades leap in every direction in a torch-lit Wei hall.

valve_text: Summon a Melee Creep into any lane.
zh_text: 在任意一路中召唤一名步卒。
en_text: Summon a Foot Soldier into any lane.
rationale: Xu Huang waited for enough men before marching to relieve Fancheng, arrived late, and still broke the siege: a single reinforcement for whichever lane needs it.
art_subject: A Wei general with a great axe leading a small relief party through flooded fields toward a besieged city wall at dusk.

valve_text: Give two random cards in opponent's hand +2 Lock.
zh_text: 使对手手牌中随机两张牌+2锁定。
en_text: Give two random cards in your opponent's hand +2 lock.
rationale: The classic delaying stratagem used throughout the novel: a lighter lock that holds the enemy back a few rounds.
art_subject: A smiling Wei envoy bowing and presenting gifts to an impatient enemy general while, behind the envoy, workers hurriedly raise a city wall.

valve_text: Choose a unit. Choose a combat target for it. Draw a card.
zh_text: 选择一个单位，为其指定交战目标。摸一张牌。
en_text: Choose a unit. Choose a combat target for it. Draw a card.
rationale: One of the Thirty-Six Stratagems: draw the tiger off its mountain to face the opponent you choose. A cheaper, card-drawing cousin of the mapped 挟天子以令诸侯.
art_subject: A great tiger stalking down from a misty mountain toward a bait goat in a clearing, Wei archers hidden in the pines around it.

valve_text: Deal 6 damage to every unit.
zh_text: 对每个单位造成6点伤害。
en_text: Deal 6 damage to every unit.
rationale: Cao Cao's notorious line after killing Lü Boshe's household (演义 ch.4), 'I would rather wrong the world than let the world wrong me': ruthless harm to friend and foe alike.
art_subject: A cold-eyed Wei lord standing with a sword in a moonlit farmhouse courtyard, overturned lanterns and fallen silhouettes all around him.

valve_text: Summon two Plague Wards.
zh_text: 召唤两名屯田兵。
en_text: Summon two Farm Soldiers.
rationale: Deng Ai's signature. He planned and ran the military-farm colonies along the Huai, where soldiers farmed and fought: two more Farm Soldiers (the Plague Ward token).
art_subject: Deng Ai on a dyke between flooded Huai river fields, pointing with his spear as soldier-farmers shoulder hoes and spears and march out in ranks under steel-blue banners.

valve_text: Summon a Meepo.
zh_text: 召唤一名夏侯渊。
en_text: Summon a Xiahou Yuan.
rationale: Xiahou Yuan's signature. Moving so fast he seemed to be on several fronts at once, he splits off another copy of himself (Valve: summon a Meepo). Engine text must use the hero's display name.
art_subject: Xiahou Yuan galloping at the head of three identical cavalry columns that fan out across a frosty plain in different directions.

valve_text: Choose a hero. Put a base copy of a random item equipped by that hero into your hand.
zh_text: 选择一名武将，将其装备的一件随机军备的基础副本置入你的手牌。
en_text: Choose a hero. Put a base copy of a random item equipped by that hero into your hand.
rationale: In 演义 ch.102 Sima Yi captures Shu's wooden oxen and has his craftsmen copy them: take an enemy's equipment and make your own.
art_subject: Wei craftsmen in a lantern-lit workshop measuring a captured wooden ox automaton while building an identical copy beside it.

valve_text: Stun a unit this round. Give that unit Damage Immunity this round.
zh_text: 本回合眩晕一个单位，并使其本回合免疫伤害。
en_text: Stun a unit this round. Give it damage immunity this round.
rationale: Chen Gong's signature. In 演义 ch.4 the magistrate Chen Gong seizes the fugitive Cao Cao, then frees him: held out of the fight, but unharmed.
art_subject: Chen Gong in magistrate's robes unlocking a wooden cangue from a captive Cao Cao in a moonlit county jail, guards frozen in surprise.

valve_text: Modify two random cards in opponent's hand with " Deal 6 damage to a random allied tower in any lane."
zh_text: 为对手手牌中随机两张牌附加：“对任意一路中一座随机友方城楼造成6点伤害。”
en_text: Modify two random cards in your opponent's hand with "Deal 6 damage to a random allied tower in any lane."
rationale: At Tong Pass Cao Cao sent Han Sui a letter full of deliberate smudges, so Ma Chao suspected treachery (演义 ch.59). Poisoning the opponent's cards so they damage their own towers is that planted suspicion.
art_subject: A letter covered in heavy ink smudges (no legible characters) lying on a war table between two glaring western warlords, a Wei agent slipping away in the shadows.

valve_text: Summon a Hound of War for every damaged unit.
zh_text: 每有一个受伤的单位，召唤一只饿虎。
en_text: Summon a Hungry Tiger for each damaged unit.
rationale: Xun Yu's signature. His 驱虎吞狼 plan (演义 ch.14) sets a tiger on a wolf; here hungry tigers fall on every wounded unit (the Hound of War token, 饿虎).
art_subject: Xun Yu calmly unrolling a scroll on a ridge while lean tigers stream down the slope toward wounded soldiers in the misty valley below.

valve_text:
Deal 2 damage to the enemy tower. Draw a card. 
 Get initiative.
zh_text: 对敌方城楼造成2点伤害。摸一张牌。获得先手。
en_text: Deal 2 damage to the enemy tower. Draw a card. Get initiative.
rationale: At Baima Xun You had Cao Cao feint toward Yanjin and then strike the real target: a hit, intelligence gained and the tempo taken.
art_subject: Wei campfires deliberately left blazing on one riverbank as the real Wei army slips across a ford in the dark toward an enemy fort.

valve_text: Each enemy has a 50% chance of being disarmed this round.
zh_text: 每个敌方单位各有50%几率在本回合被缴械。
en_text: Each enemy has a 50% chance of being disarmed this round.
rationale: Generals raised fake banners and dust clouds (疑兵) so the enemy hesitated: some freeze and some don't, a coin-flip disarm.
art_subject: Straw dummies in Wei armour and dozens of blank banners lining a misty hillside, a wary enemy army hesitating below.

valve_text: Repeat one time for each charge: Deal 3 piercing damage to a random enemy.
zh_text: 每有一层充能，重复一次：对一个随机敌方单位造成3点穿透伤害。
en_text: Repeat once for each charge: deal 3 piercing damage to a random enemy.
rationale: Zhen Ji's signature. Legend ties her to Cao Zhi's 洛神赋; her passive charges the Ode, and the stored verses fall on the enemy as moonlight.
art_subject: Zhen Ji drifting over moonlit river water in flowing indigo silks, crescent blades of pale light falling from an eclipsed moon onto an enemy camp on the far bank.

valve_text: Deal 12 damage evenly divided among a unit and its allied neighbors.
zh_text: 将12点伤害平均分配给一个单位及其友方邻位单位。
en_text: Deal 12 damage divided evenly among a unit and its allied neighbors.
rationale: Dian Wei's signature. At Puyang he held a dozen short halberds and hurled them into the enemy as they closed (三国志 典韦传): damage split across a group.
art_subject: Dian Wei, massive and bare-armed, hurling a fan of short halberds from both hands into a cluster of charging enemy soldiers.

valve_text: Give three random cards in opponent's hand +3 Lock.
zh_text: 使对手手牌中随机三张牌+3锁定。
en_text: Give three random cards in your opponent's hand +3 lock.
rationale: Sima Yi stalled Zhuge Liang by asking the distant emperor for leave to fight, knowing it would be refused; the enemy's plans sat waiting. Heavy lock on several cards is that delay.
art_subject: A Wei courier galloping along an endless frosty road with a sealed petition tube while an enemy army waits idle behind its palisade in the distance.

valve_text: Summon two Melee Creeps into any lane.
zh_text: 在任意一路中召唤两名步卒。
en_text: Summon two Foot Soldiers into any lane.
rationale: Wei's saying about Xiahou Yuan's troops, 'three days, five hundred li; six days, a thousand': reinforcements that appear in any lane.
art_subject: A column of dust-covered Wei foot soldiers jogging at speed along a mountain road at dawn, banners streaming, a besieged fort waiting ahead.

valve_text: Choose two enemies. They battle each other.
zh_text: 选择两个敌方单位，令它们相互交锋。
en_text: Choose two enemies. They battle each other.
rationale: Xun Yu's 二虎竞食之计 (演义 ch.14): give one prize to two rivals, Liu Bei and Lü Bu, so they fight each other.
art_subject: Two snarling tigers circling a single carcass on a misty ridge, while a calm Wei strategist watches from a pavilion far above.

valve_text: Deal 5 damage to each enemy across from an empty combat position.
zh_text: 对每个正对空交战位置的敌方单位造成5点伤害。
en_text: Deal 5 damage to each enemy across from an empty combat position.
rationale: Cheng Yu's ten-sided ambush against Yuan Shao at Cangting (演义 ch.31): the empty ground before the enemy was full of hidden troops.
art_subject: Wei soldiers rising from tall frosted reeds on every side of a startled enemy column on a seemingly empty plain at dawn.

valve_text: Deal damage to each enemy equal to the number of enemies.
zh_text: 对每个敌方单位造成等同于敌方单位数量的伤害。
en_text: Deal damage to each enemy equal to the number of enemies.
rationale: Zhang Liao's signature. After Xiaoyao Ford, Wu mothers hushed crying children with 'Zhang Liao is coming': the more enemies there are, the further the terror spreads.
art_subject: Zhang Liao's charging silhouette looming out of a storm over a crowded Wu army camp, soldiers scattering and falling in a widening shockwave of panic.

valve_text: Deal 20 damage to the enemy tower.
zh_text: 对敌方城楼造成20点伤害。
en_text: Deal 20 damage to the enemy tower.
rationale: Cao Cao's night raid that burned Yuan Shao's grain depot at Wuchao decided Guandu at a stroke. Blue's most expensive spell is that single crushing blow to the enemy tower.
art_subject: Wei raiders silhouetted against an enormous night blaze consuming a vast walled granary, embers and smoke rising into a cold indigo sky.

valve_text: Swap an ally with one of its allied neighbors.
zh_text: 将一个友方单位与其一个友方邻位单位交换位置。
en_text: Swap an ally with one of its allied neighbors.
rationale: One of the Thirty-Six Stratagems: leave an empty shell behind and slip into a new position.
art_subject: In a moonlit reed marsh, an empty suit of armour propped on a pole while its owner slips away unseen into the reeds beside a comrade.

valve_text: Purge your opponent's effects from a unit. Give that unit +2 Armor and +2 Retaliate this round.
zh_text: 驱散对手施加于一个单位的所有效果。本回合使其+2护甲、+2反击。
en_text: Purge your opponent's effects from a unit. Give it +2 armor and +2 retaliate this round.
rationale: Zhou Tai's signature. At Xuancheng he covered Sun Quan with his own body and took a dozen wounds: he shields the unit, strips the enemy's effects and strikes back.
art_subject: Zhou Tai, scarred and bleeding, spreading his arms and round shield in front of a young lord as torches and spears close in at night.

valve_text: Modify a unit with "This unit's allied neighbors have +2 Armor."
zh_text: 永久使一个单位获得：“此单位的友方邻位单位+2护甲。”
en_text: Permanently give a unit "This unit's allied neighbors have +2 armor."
rationale: Wu's defensive doctrine: one soldier anchors the shield line and protects the men beside him.
art_subject: A Wu officer planting a tall lacquered shield at the centre of a locked shield wall, comrades on each side bracing behind it.

valve_text: Move a creep to a random other lane.
zh_text: 将一名兵卒移至随机的另一路。
en_text: Move a creep to a random other lane.
rationale: Thundering war drums threw enemy squads into confusion: a cheap spell scatters one troop into another lane.
art_subject: A bare-armed drummer pounding a huge war drum on a ship's prow while startled enemy soldiers scatter in the mist beyond.

valve_text: Give a unit in any lane +3 Armor until end of its next combat phase.
zh_text: 使任意一路中的一个单位+3护甲，直至其下一个交战阶段结束。
en_text: Give a unit in any lane +3 armor until the end of its next combat phase.
rationale: Hide-covered mengchong warships darted anywhere on the river to screen troops: a cheap armor buff that reaches any lane.
art_subject: A low, hide-armoured mengchong warship sliding between a stranded soldier and a hail of arrows, which bounce off its leather roof.

valve_text: Choose a lane. Modify allies in that lane with +3 Health.
zh_text: 选择一路，永久使该路中的友方单位+3体力。
en_text: Choose a lane. Permanently give allies in that lane +3 health.
rationale: Wu lords feasted the troops after each victory: every soldier in one chosen lane is fed and made sturdier for good.
art_subject: Rows of Wu soldiers raising wine bowls at long tables piled with fish and rice on a lantern-lit riverside pier, green war-junk sails behind.

valve_text: Give a unit "Deal 2 piercing damage to this unit before the action phase" until it dies.
zh_text: 使一个单位获得“行动阶段前，对此单位造成2点穿透伤害”，直至其阵亡。
en_text: Give a unit "Before the action phase, deal 2 piercing damage to this unit" until it dies.
rationale: Huang Gai's signature. His fire ships sailed in under a false surrender and set Cao's chained fleet burning round after round. Avoids the reserved 苦肉计 and 火烧赤壁.
art_subject: Huang Gai on the prow of a small boat packed with oil-soaked reeds, white surrender flag in hand, as the boats behind him burst into flame against a dark enemy fleet.

valve_text: Modify a unit with +3 Attack and +3 Cleave.
zh_text: 永久使一个单位+3攻击、+3横扫。
en_text: Permanently give a unit +3 attack and +3 cleave.
rationale: Sun Ce's signature. 激昂 is his 三国杀 skill: the Little Conqueror's fire passes into whoever he leads, a big permanent attack and cleave.
art_subject: Sun Ce with spear raised on a riverbank, clapping a young soldier on the shoulder as the soldier's blade flares with golden light and the ranks behind roar.

valve_text: Modify a unit with +3 Retaliate.
zh_text: 永久使一个单位+3反击。
en_text: Permanently give a unit +3 retaliate.
rationale: Taishi Ci's signature. At Shenting Ridge he fought Sun Ce to a standstill, each snatching the other's weapon and helmet: a unit that strikes back at every attacker.
art_subject: Taishi Ci and a young Wu lord grappling on horseback on a misty ridge, one gripping the other's spear and the other holding a snatched helmet.

valve_text: Summon two Roseleaf Walls.
zh_text: 召唤两座拒马。
en_text: Summon two Spiked Barricades.
rationale: On Lü Meng's advice Wu built the Ruxu dock-fort, which held off Cao Cao's invasions: barricades raised out of nothing (the Roseleaf Wall token, 拒马).
art_subject: Wu soldiers hammering sharpened timber stakes into a riverbank to form a fortified dock, war-junks moored behind the new palisade.

valve_text: Modify a green hero with "Allies have +2 Regeneration."
zh_text: 永久使一名绿色武将获得：“友方单位+2再生。”
en_text: Permanently give a green hero "Allies have +2 regeneration."
rationale: Xiao Qiao's signature. Her marriage to Zhou Yu, the commander famed for his ear for music, is the harmony that heals the whole army.
art_subject: Xiao Qiao playing a guqin on a riverside pavilion while a commander in green listens, soft notes of light drifting over resting Wu soldiers.

valve_text: Heal your tower 8.
zh_text: 为你的城楼恢复8点体力。
en_text: Heal your tower 8.
rationale: Sun Quan built the Stone City fortress at Jianye in 212 to guard his capital: rebuilding the walls restores the tower.
art_subject: Labourers hauling and stacking great grey stones to raise a fortress wall on a cliff above the river, scaffolding and pulleys silhouetted in mist.

valve_text: Modify a hero with "After you play a green card, give this hero and its allied neighbors +4 Regeneration this round."
zh_text: 永久使一名武将获得：“你打出一张绿色牌后，本回合使此武将及其友方邻位单位+4再生。”
en_text: Permanently give a hero "After you play a green card, give this hero and its allied neighbors +4 regeneration this round."
rationale: The military maxim of resting troops to restore their strength before battle: each green card lets the general and his flankers recover again.
art_subject: A Wu general and his officers resting beside a spring under willow trees, armour loosened, fresh green light filtering through the branches.

valve_text: Purge your opponent's effects from a hero.
zh_text: 驱散对手施加于一名武将的所有效果。
en_text: Purge your opponent's effects from a hero.
rationale: The Han spring rite of 祓禊, bathing at the riverside to wash away misfortune, cleanses a general of enemy effects.
art_subject: A Wu general kneeling at the river's edge as a robed ritualist pours water from a bronze vessel over his hands, mist and willow catkins drifting.

valve_text: Stun a hero until they equip an item.
zh_text: 眩晕一名武将，直至其装备一件军备。
en_text: Stun a hero until they equip an item.
rationale: Lu Xun sent Guan Yu humble, flattering letters until he dropped his guard at Jingzhou: the general is frozen until he takes up arms again.
art_subject: A proud bearded general lounging in his tent, smiling over an unrolled letter (no legible text), his weapon rack neglected behind him.

valve_text: Give a unit -4 Attack this round and give another unit +4 Attack this round.
zh_text: 本回合使一个单位-4攻击，并使另一个单位+4攻击。
en_text: Give a unit -4 attack this round and give another unit +4 attack this round.
rationale: One of the Thirty-Six Stratagems: secretly take the supports from one side and give them to another.
art_subject: A sly Wu officer slipping a heavy halberd from a sleeping enemy's rack and passing it to a waiting comrade in a shadowy camp.

valve_text: Condemn all equipped items.
zh_text: 处斩所有已装备的军备。
en_text: Condemn all equipped items.
rationale: At Red Cliffs Cao Cao's northern army fell sick in the damp southern air. The miasma rots every piece of gear on the field.
art_subject: Thick yellow-green fog rolling over a riverside camp, with rusting spears, rotting lamellar and corroded helmets heaped on the muddy bank.

valve_text: Give allies Damage Immunity this round.
zh_text: 本回合所有友方单位免疫伤害。
en_text: Give allies damage immunity this round.
rationale: The Yangtze was Wu's natural moat (天堑), which no northern army could cross: for one round nothing can harm your side.
art_subject: A vast misty Yangtze separating a calm Wu shore from a distant northern army, whose arrows fall short into the churning water.

valve_text: Move a unit to a random other lane.
zh_text: 将一个单位移至随机的另一路。
en_text: Move a unit to a random other lane.
rationale: In 224 Xu Sheng raised hundreds of li of false walls along the Yangtze overnight, and Cao Pi's army turned back in alarm: any unit, heroes included, is forced to another lane.
art_subject: At dawn, endless painted cloth walls and towers line the misty Yangtze shore while an awed enemy fleet turns away in the distance.

valve_text: Modify enemy heroes with -2 Attack.
zh_text: 永久使所有敌方武将-2攻击。
en_text: Permanently give enemy heroes -2 attack.
rationale: In the novel Cao Cao's northern generals cannot adapt to southern water and climate: every enemy general is permanently weakened.
art_subject: Feverish northern generals in heavy iron armour sagging over the rail of a rocking warship, pale and seasick, under a damp grey southern sky.

valve_text: Fully heal each ally. Give allies Damage Immunity this round.
zh_text: 完全恢复每个友方单位的体力。本回合所有友方单位免疫伤害。
en_text: Fully heal each ally. Give allies damage immunity this round.
rationale: Lu Su's signature. He pointed to one of his two granaries and gave it all to Zhou Yu's hungry troops (三国志 鲁肃传): his generosity restores the whole army.
art_subject: Lu Su in green scholar robes pointing to an open granary as grain pours out to a line of weary, grateful soldiers in warm light.

valve_text: Modify a unit with Damage Immunity.
zh_text: 永久使一个单位免疫伤害。
en_text: Permanently give a unit damage immunity.
rationale: The one Heaven favours cannot be harmed: an expensive, permanent immunity, Wu's claim to the throne.
art_subject: A lone Wu commander standing unharmed in a beam of golden light from parting clouds while arrows fall away around him on a river bluff.

valve_text: Deal 2 damage to a unit in any lane.
zh_text: 对任意一路中的一个单位造成2点伤害。
en_text: Deal 2 damage to a unit in any lane.
rationale: Stray arrows (流矢) fell officers all through the chronicles of the era: a cheap, small hit that can land in any lane.
art_subject: A single black-fletched arrow streaking through drifting smoke over a chaotic battlefield toward a distant officer's helmet plume.

valve_text: Choose a unit in another lane. Move a random allied black hero from this lane to that lane. Deal 2 damage to the chosen unit.
zh_text: 选择另一路中的一个单位。将本路中一名随机友方黑色武将移至该路，并对所选单位造成2点伤害。
en_text: Choose a unit in another lane. Move a random allied black hero from this lane to that lane. Deal 2 damage to the chosen unit.
rationale: The classical phrase for running down a beaten foe: a warlord crosses lanes to chase its prey and wounds it.
art_subject: A black-armoured rider galloping over a ridge after scattering fugitives, dust and torn banners trailing behind.

valve_text: Give the enemy tower -2 Mana this round and give your tower +2 Mana this round.
zh_text: 本回合使敌方城楼-2军令，你的城楼+2军令。
en_text: Give the enemy tower -2 mana this round and give your tower +2 mana this round.
rationale: Zuo Ci's signature. At Cao Cao's own feast (演义 ch.68) he conjures fish and dragon's liver, empties the wine and flings the cup: he takes the host's resources for himself.
art_subject: Zuo Ci, a lean one-eyed Daoist, tossing a wine cup that turns into a white dove above a banquet hall while a furious lord rises from his seat.

valve_text: Deal damage to the enemy tower equal to the total Armor on enemies.
zh_text: 对敌方城楼造成伤害，数值等于所有敌方单位的护甲之和。
en_text: Deal damage to the enemy tower equal to the total armor of all enemies.
rationale: In the late-Han chaos armoured guards turned on their own masters again and again (Lü Bu on Ding Yuan, then on Dong Zhuo). The better armed the enemy's men, the worse the damage when they turn on their own walls.
art_subject: Heavily armoured soldiers wheeling around at a city gate and levelling their spears at their own walls and banners, their commander shouting in vain amid smoke.

valve_text: Deal 2 damage to the enemy tower for each of its improvements.
zh_text: 敌方城楼每有一个营建，对其造成2点伤害。
en_text: Deal 2 damage to the enemy tower for each of its improvements.
rationale: Saboteurs set fire to the enemy's fortifications, and the more works there are, the bigger the fire.
art_subject: Shadowed saboteurs slipping away from a burning palisade as watchtowers and siege works catch flame behind them.

valve_text: Double your gold.
zh_text: 使你的金翻倍。
en_text: Double your gold.
rationale: 三国志 董卓传: Dong Zhuo melted down bronze statues and minted flimsy small coins, multiplying the money supply overnight.
art_subject: A palace courtyard furnace where toppled bronze statues are melted and cascades of thin cheap coins pour from moulds.

valve_text: Give a hero +10 Bounty until it dies.
zh_text: 使一名武将+10赏金，直至其阵亡。
en_text: Give a hero +10 bounty until it dies.
rationale: Yuan Shao's signature. Chen Lin's proclamation for Yuan Shao promised a marquisate and fifty million cash for Cao Cao's head: a price on the target until it dies.
art_subject: Yuan Shao in gilded armour holding up a long proclamation scroll (no legible text) before massed banners, heralds riding off with copies in every direction.

valve_text: Move an allied black hero to an empty combat position in any lane.
zh_text: 将一名友方黑色武将移至任意一路中的一个空交战位置。
en_text: Move an allied black hero to an empty combat position in any lane.
rationale: Gao Shun's signature. In 198 Lü Bu sent Gao Shun and Zhang Liao to strike Liu Bei at Xiaopei, and they took it: a sudden reposition into any lane.
art_subject: Gao Shun leading black-armoured shock troops through a broken town gate at dawn, the defenders' banners falling.

valve_text: Modify a black hero with "Deal 2 piercing damage to this hero's enemy neighbors before the action phase."
zh_text: 永久使一名黑色武将获得：“行动阶段前，对此武将的敌方邻位单位造成2点穿透伤害。”
en_text: Permanently give a black hero "Before the action phase, deal 2 piercing damage to this hero's enemy neighbors."
rationale: Hua Tuo's signature, the name the mapping reserved for him. His anaesthetic's numbing vapour hangs around the hero and slowly stops the hearts of anyone beside him.
art_subject: Hua Tuo in dark robes grinding powder in a bronze mortar as pale green vapour curls outward toward sagging shadowy soldiers.

valve_text: Silence a unit this round. Give that unit +4 Attack this round.
zh_text: 本回合使一个单位沉默，并使其+4攻击。
en_text: Silence a unit this round. Give it +4 attack this round.
rationale: Dong Zhuo's signature, after his 三国杀 skills 酒池 and 肉林: drunk on excess, the unit loses its abilities but strikes far harder.
art_subject: Dong Zhuo, bloated and armoured, roaring at a blood-red banquet table among overturned wine jars and roasted meat, drifting smoke behind.

valve_text: Modify the enemy tower with -1 Mana.
zh_text: 永久使敌方城楼-1军令。
en_text: Permanently give the enemy tower -1 mana.
rationale: Severing the grain road was the period's standard way to cripple an army for good: the enemy loses 1 Command permanently.
art_subject: Black-clad raiders setting fire to a column of grain carts on a mountain road at dusk while oxen bolt.

valve_text: Choose an allied black hero. Choose another unit in any lane. They battle each other.
zh_text: 选择一名友方黑色武将，再选择任意一路中的另一个单位，令二者相互交锋。
en_text: Choose an allied black hero. Choose another unit in any lane. They battle each other.
rationale: Huang Zu's archers lay in wait at Mount Xian and cut down Sun Jian as he rode ahead alone: a lone target dragged into a fight on the ambusher's terms, from any lane.
art_subject: Archers and swordsmen springing from a bamboo thicket on a mountain path at a lone galloping rider.

valve_text: Give a black hero +8 Attack this round. Choose a combat target for it.
zh_text: 本回合使一名黑色武将+8攻击，并为其指定交战目标。
en_text: Give a black hero +8 attack this round. Choose a combat target for it.
rationale: Emperor Xian's secret edict, sewn into a jade belt, named the man to kill and armed the conspirators: a big strike at a chosen target.
art_subject: Trembling hands unpicking a jade belt by candlelight to reveal a hidden blood-stained silk (no legible characters), a dagger lying beside it.

valve_text: Modify a black hero with "After you play a black card, give this hero and its allied neighbors +2 Attack this round."
zh_text: 永久使一名黑色武将获得：“你打出一张黑色牌后，本回合使此武将及其友方邻位单位+2攻击。”
en_text: Permanently give a black hero "After you play a black card, give this hero and its allied neighbors +2 attack this round."
rationale: The coalition of eighteen lords against Dong Zhuo (演义 ch.5): each new scheme rallies the lord and the allies beside him.
art_subject: A torch-lit ridge crowded with many warlords' blank banners as generals raise their swords together toward a distant mountain pass.

valve_text: Modify a black hero with +3 Siege.
zh_text: 永久使一名黑色武将+3攻城。
en_text: Permanently give a black hero +3 siege.
rationale: Li Jue and Guo Si turned their troops loose on Chang'an: a warlord whose army plunders does lasting damage to cities.
art_subject: A mounted warlord watching his troops loot a burning city gate, carts heaped with plunder.

valve_text: Disarm a unit until end of round. That unit's allied neighbors battle it.
zh_text: 本回合使一个单位缴械。其友方邻位单位与其交锋。
en_text: Disarm a unit until the end of the round. Its allied neighbors battle it.
rationale: Diaochan's signature. 离间 is her 三国杀 skill: she set Lü Bu against Dong Zhuo, so an enemy's own men turn on it.
art_subject: Diaochan, half-veiled under a moonlit pavilion, smiling faintly while two armoured warlords behind her glare at each other with drawn blades.

valve_text: Deal 10 piercing damage to a unit in any lane.
zh_text: 对任意一路中的一个单位造成10点穿透伤害。
en_text: Deal 10 piercing damage to a unit in any lane.
rationale: Lady Zhurong's signature. 演义 ch.90 calls her a descendant of the fire god Zhurong; her longest throw is a killing blade that reaches any lane.
art_subject: Lady Zhurong at full gallop hurling a single burning knife that streaks like a comet across a dark jungle sky toward a distant target.

valve_text:
Deal 3 damage to a unit. Repeat 7 times: Deal 3 damage to a random unit to its left or right. 
 Get initiative.
zh_text: 对一个单位造成3点伤害。重复7次：对其左侧或右侧的一个随机单位造成3点伤害。获得先手。
en_text: Deal 3 damage to a unit. Repeat 7 times: deal 3 damage to a random unit to its left or right. Get initiative.
rationale: Meng Huo's signature. Captured and freed seven times, he came back every time: the strike that lashes the line again and again (7 repeats) is his seven returns.
art_subject: Meng Huo in war paint bursting free of ropes, a chain of snapped bonds and spirit-light whipping from soldier to soldier through the jungle mist.

valve_text: Move an allied black hero to another lane. Give that hero +4 Attack and +7 Siege until end of its next combat phase.
zh_text: 将一名友方黑色武将移至另一路。直至其下一个交战阶段结束，使其+4攻击、+7攻城。
en_text: Move an allied black hero to another lane. Give it +4 attack and +7 siege until the end of its next combat phase.
rationale: Night raiders bit wooden gags (衔枚) to march in silence: the hero slips unseen into another lane and falls on the walls.
art_subject: A column of shadowy soldiers with gag sticks in their mouths creeping under a moonless sky toward a sleeping fortress gate.

valve_text: Active 2: Spend all your gold. Modify Mercenary Exiles with +X Attack and +X Health where X is half the gold spent.
zh_text: 倾囊募兵：花费你所有的金，然后永久使东州兵+X攻击、+X体力，X为所花费金的一半。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text: Empty the Purse: spend all your gold, then permanently give Dongzhou Exiles +X attack and +X health, where X is half the gold spent. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: The Dongzhou troops were refugees from the Central Plains whom the lords of Yi Province paid to fight. Pour in gold and they grow.
art_subject: A hard-faced refugee soldier in mismatched armour weighing a jingling purse of coins in one hand, a notched sword resting on his shoulder.

valve_text: When Hellbear Crippler deals battle damage to a unit, modify that unit with -1 Attack.
zh_text: 绊马索兵对一个单位造成战斗伤害时，永久使该单位-1攻击。
en_text: When Snare-Rope Troops deal battle damage to a unit, permanently give that unit -1 attack.
rationale: Snare ropes stretched across a path threw riders and hobbled horses. Anything they hurt fights weaker for good.
art_subject: A crouching Shu soldier yanking a taut rope across a forest trail, a horse stumbling and its rider pitching forward in the background.

valve_text: Play Effect: Modify a random allied hero with +2 Attack.
zh_text: 出场效果：永久使一名随机友方武将+2攻击。
en_text: Play effect: permanently give a random allied hero +2 attack.
rationale: Pu Yuan, Shu's master swordsmith, forged 3,000 blades for Zhuge Liang's army (蒲元传). His smiths arm a hero when they arrive.
art_subject: A sweat-streaked Shu swordsmith in a leather apron holding up a freshly quenched blade glowing orange, sparks and steam rising from the forge behind him.

valve_text: After the combat phase, if Rebel Instigator dealt battle damage to a creep this round, summon a Rebel Instigator.
zh_text: 交战阶段后，若涿郡义兵本回合对兵卒造成了战斗伤害，召唤一支涿郡义兵。
en_text: After the combat phase, if Zhuo Volunteers dealt battle damage to a creep this round, summon a Zhuo Volunteers.
rationale: Liu Bei's first army was village volunteers from Zhuo who swelled with every victory over the rebels: when they win a fight, more join.
art_subject: A rough farmer-turned-soldier with a sharpened hoe-spear and a red headband rallying fellow villagers behind him, waving them forward.

valve_text: Legion Standard Bearer's allied neighbors have +4 Attack.
zh_text: 牙门旗手的友方邻位单位+4攻击。
en_text: Yamen Standard Bearer's allied neighbors have +4 attack.
rationale: Shu's 牙门 command banner (the rank Wang Ping and Wei Yan held) marked where the army rallied. The 0/0/6 bearer cannot fight but drives the soldiers beside him.
art_subject: A stout, unarmed soldier planting a huge plain crimson command banner with both hands, the cloth snapping in the wind above the battle line.

valve_text: Modify Stonehall Elite with +2 Attack and +2 Health after a unit blocking it dies.
zh_text: 阻挡虎步军的单位阵亡后，永久使虎步军+2攻击、+2体力。
en_text: Permanently give Tiger-Step Elite +2 attack and +2 health after a unit blocking it dies.
rationale: Zhuge Liang's 虎步 guard were Shu's elite heavy infantry, and they grew bolder with every foe they cut down.
art_subject: An elite Shu infantryman in tiger-striped lamellar armour and a tiger-mask helmet, stepping over a fallen foe with a halberd raised.

valve_text: Deal 2 piercing damage to the enemy tower after an allied Melee Creep dies.
zh_text: 一名友方步卒阵亡后，对敌方城楼造成2点穿透伤害。
en_text: Deal 2 piercing damage to the enemy tower after an allied Foot Soldier dies.
rationale: Shu's repeating crossbows shot over the front line at the walls. Each fallen Foot Soldier (the melee_creep token) clears their line of fire.
art_subject: A sturdy Shu crossbowman behind a wooden mantlet, loading a box-magazine repeating crossbow aimed upward toward distant fortress walls.

valve_text: Summon a Zombie for your opponent after the combat phase.
zh_text: 交战阶段后，为你的对手召唤一名阴兵。
en_text: Summon a Ghost Soldier for your opponent after the combat phase.
rationale: Zhuge Liang's southern army crossed the Lu River, where the restless dead rose until he appeased them with offerings (演义 ch.91). These hardened veterans fight well (6/0/6), but the ghosts they leave behind rise for the enemy (the Zombie token, 阴兵).
art_subject: A grim Shu veteran wading out of a misty river at night, crimson armour streaming water, pale ghostly soldiers rising from the current behind him.

valve_text: After the combat phase, if Red Mist Pillager dealt battle damage to a tower this round, summon a Red Mist Pillager.
zh_text: 交战阶段后，若西凉铁骑本回合对城楼造成了战斗伤害，召唤一支西凉铁骑。
en_text: After the combat phase, if Xiliang Iron Cavalry dealt battle damage to a tower this round, summon a Xiliang Iron Cavalry.
rationale: Ma Chao's northwestern horsemen followed him into Shu. Raiders who break through to the walls bring more riders.
art_subject: A northwestern horseman in fur-trimmed iron armour galloping hard past a smoking fortress wall, a dust plume of more riders behind him.

valve_text: Play Effect: Discard your hand.
zh_text: 出场效果：弃置你的所有手牌。
en_text: Play effect: discard your hand.
rationale: Zhuge Liang's wooden ox is the era's legendary machine. A 13/0/13 construct whose cost, building it, uses up every resource you hold.
art_subject: A towering wooden ox automaton of interlocking timbers, gears and bronze fittings striding forward along a mountain plank road.

zh_text: 兵卒：6攻击，0护甲，16体力。
en_text: Creep: 6 attack, 0 armor, 16 health.
rationale: The Ba region's 'board-shield' tribesmen were famed since the Han as nearly unbreakable fighters, which fits a huge-health vanilla 6/0/16.
art_subject: A massive tribal warrior from the Ba hills behind a tall painted wooden board-shield, bare-armed and tattooed, with a heavy club braced to strike.

valve_text: Play Effect: Give Relentless Zombie a Death Shield.
zh_text: 出场效果：使敢死士获得免死护盾。
en_text: Play effect: give Dare-to-Die Men a death shield.
rationale: Han armies raised dare-to-die volunteers (敢死之士) who fought on after wounds that should have killed them: a cheap creep that cheats death once.
art_subject: A scarred Wei volunteer in battered lamellar with a broken spear, staggering back to his feet with grim resolve amid drifting smoke.

valve_text: Active 1: Fully restore your tower's Mana.
zh_text: 开仓调粮：完全恢复你城楼的军令。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text: Open the Granary: fully restore your tower's mana. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: Wei's 典农校尉 officers ran the military farms that fed Cao Cao's armies; this officer refills the tower's Command every round.
art_subject: A Wei farm-colony official in practical robes and light armour throwing open granary doors as sacks of grain are loaded onto army carts.

valve_text: Draw an extra card each round.
zh_text: 你每回合额外摸一张牌。
en_text: Draw an extra card each round.
rationale: Guan Lu was Wei's most famous diviner (三国志 方技传; he reads fates for Cao Cao in 演义 ch.69). A soothsayer who sees ahead is an extra card each round.
art_subject: An eccentric Wei diviner in rumpled robes casting yarrow stalks before a bronze divination board, star patterns glowing faintly in the mist.

valve_text: Fully restore your tower's Mana after you play any card.
zh_text: 你每打出一张牌后，完全恢复你城楼的军令。
en_text: Fully restore your tower's mana after you play any card.
rationale: Cao Zhi, author of the 洛神赋, was said to hold eight of the world's ten measures of talent (才高八斗) and composed a poem in seven paces. An inspiration that never runs dry refills Command after every card. Pairs with Zhen Ji's signature.
art_subject: The young poet-prince Cao Zhi in indigo court robes, brush raised over a long blank scroll on a moonlit terrace above a misty river.

valve_text: Death Effect: Modify allies with +1 Attack and +1 Health.
zh_text: 阵亡效果：永久使所有友方单位+1攻击、+1体力。
en_text: Death effect: permanently give allies +1 attack and +1 health.
rationale: Danyang was famed for fierce recruits who fought to the death; their sacrifice hardens everyone who survives.
art_subject: A grim young Danyang soldier with a short blade charging forward alone, headband streaming, as his comrades rally behind him.

valve_text: Active 1: Swap Rebel Decoy with another ally.
zh_text: 换帻诱敌：将祖茂与另一个友方单位交换位置。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text: Swapped Headscarf: swap Zu Mao with another ally. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: When Hua Xiong routed Sun Jian, his officer Zu Mao put on Sun Jian's red headscarf to draw off the pursuers (三国志 孙坚传): he swaps places with an ally.
art_subject: A loyal officer tying a red headscarf onto his own head in a moonlit forest while pursuing torches close in behind him.

valve_text: Play Effect: Modify a random allied hero with +1 Armor.
zh_text: 出场效果：永久使一名随机友方武将+1护甲。
en_text: Play effect: permanently give a random allied hero +1 armor.
rationale: Wu and Yue were famed for metalwork since the legendary smiths Gan Jiang and Mo Ye: the smith reinforces a general's armour on arrival.
art_subject: A soot-streaked smith in a leather apron hammering a glowing lamellar plate at a riverside forge, sparks flying in teal shadow.

valve_text: Modify Satyr Duelist with +2 Attack after the combat phase.
zh_text: 交战阶段后，永久使吴钩剑客+2攻击。
en_text: Permanently give Wu Hook Duelist +2 attack after the combat phase.
rationale: The curved Wu hook (吴钩) was Jiangdong's famous blade: the duelist grows deadlier with every fight.
art_subject: A lean swordsman in a teal sash crouched in a dueling stance with a curved hook-sword, rain dripping from a reed-thatched roof behind him.

valve_text: Modify Rampaging Hellbear with +4 Attack after the combat phase.
zh_text: 交战阶段后，永久使山越蛮兵+4攻击。
en_text: Permanently give Shanyue Berserkers +4 attack after the combat phase.
rationale: The Shanyue hill peoples fought Wu for generations and were then drafted into its armies: wild, and fiercer with each battle.
art_subject: A muscular hill warrior with bone ornaments and a heavy axe roaring as he charges down a misty mountain slope. Dignified, not a caricature.

valve_text: Your tower has +1 Mana.
zh_text: 你的城楼+1军令。
en_text: Your tower has +1 mana.
rationale: Lu Xun's signature. The Lu were one of Wu's four great clans (顾陆朱张), and their private retainers fed and manned the war effort: extra Command every round.
art_subject: Armed Lu clan retainers in teal livery unloading grain and arrows at a riverside manor gate under the clan's banner, Lu Xun watching from the steps.

valve_text: Fully heal Selfish Cleric after the combat phase.
zh_text: 交战阶段后，完全恢复越巫的体力。
en_text: Fully heal Yue Shaman after the combat phase.
rationale: The shamans of the old Yue lands were known for healing rites; this one heals only itself after each fight.
art_subject: A hooded southern shaman with a bronze bell and herb pouch chanting over his own glowing wound in a fern-filled forest clearing.

valve_text: Revtel Convoy has +X Attack where X is equal to half your gold.
zh_text: 漕船队+X攻击，X为你的金的一半。
en_text: Grain Barge Fleet has +X attack, where X is half your gold.
