rationale: Wu's wealth moved along its rivers and canals by barge: the richer your treasury, the harder the convoy hits. Zero base attack and 20 health suit a cargo fleet.
art_subject: A heavily laden river barge stacked with grain sacks and bronze-bound chests pushing through morning mist, armed boatmen on deck.

valve_text: Play Effect: Modify Champion of the Ancient with +1 Attack, +1 Health, and +1 Cleave for each enemy.
zh_text: 出场效果：每有一个敌方单位，永久使无难军+1攻击、+1体力、+1横扫。
en_text: Play effect: permanently give Wunan Guard +1 attack, +1 health and +1 cleave for each enemy.
rationale: Wu's elite palace troops (无难督), whose name means 'no danger': the more enemies on the field, the stronger they arrive.
art_subject: A towering guardsman in ornate teal lamellar planting a long glaive before a palace gate, ready to cut down many foes at once.

valve_text: Play Effect: Heal your tower 7.
zh_text: 出场效果：为你的城楼恢复7点体力。
en_text: Play effect: heal your tower 7.
rationale: Dong Feng, a physician of the Wu lands, asked cured patients to plant apricot trees instead of paying, which gave Chinese medicine the name 杏林: a healer who mends the walls on arrival.
art_subject: A white-bearded physician in green robes beneath a blossoming apricot grove, holding a medicine gourd as petals drift toward a mended city wall.

valve_text: Active 1: Modify allies with +2 Attack and +2 Health.
zh_text: 两国通好：永久使所有友方单位+2攻击、+2体力。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text: Envoy of Alliance: permanently give allies +2 attack and +2 health. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: Zhuge Liang's elder brother was Wu's patient envoy to Shu who kept the alliance alive: a frail emissary who strengthens the whole side every round. Not one of the reserve heroes.
art_subject: A calm, long-faced elder envoy in green court robes holding out a sealed letter of alliance on a riverside pavilion, banners stirring behind him.

zh_text: 兵卒：25攻击，0护甲，25体力。
en_text: Creep: 25 attack, 0 armor, 25 health.
rationale: 飞云 was the name of one of Sun Quan's real giant warships, larger even than the mapped Tower Ship: a plain 25/25 behemoth for 9 mana.
art_subject: A colossal multi-deck Wu flagship with layered pavilions and vast batwing sails looming bow-on out of the river mist, dwarfing the boats around it. Use the Tower Ship vehicle framing.

valve_text: Active 1: Choose a combat target for Assassin's Apprentice.
zh_text: 受命行刺：为游侠儿指定交战目标。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text: Marked Target: choose a combat target for Young Knight-Errant. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: Han 游侠 youths sold their swords to settle other men's feuds: a cheap creep that picks its own target.
art_subject: A young swordsman in black with a short sword, eyes locked on an unseen target, crouched on a rooftop under the moon.

valve_text: Deal 2 piercing damage to the enemy tower before the action phase.
zh_text: 行动阶段前，对敌方城楼造成2点穿透伤害。
en_text: Deal 2 piercing damage to the enemy tower before the action phase.
rationale: Hill bandits hurled stones from slings over the walls day after day: no attack of their own, only steady piercing damage to the tower. (发石车 is avoided because it is the same machine as the mapped 霹雳车.)
art_subject: A ragged bandit whirling a leather sling overhead, a stone arcing away toward a distant wall, piles of river stones at his feet.

valve_text: Other allies have +2 Attack and -2 Armor.
zh_text: 其他友方单位+2攻击、-2护甲。
en_text: Other allies have +2 attack and -2 armor.
rationale: Taiping preachers handed out talisman water (符水) and promised believers they could not be harmed, so the faithful charged recklessly.
art_subject: A gaunt preacher in yellow-trimmed black robes lifting a bowl of talisman water as ash and incense smoke spiral upward.

valve_text: The enemy tower has -1 Mana.
zh_text: 敌方城楼-1军令。
en_text: The enemy tower has -1 mana.
rationale: Palace eunuchs held back and buried memorials, choking the court's orders: a durable body with little attack that drains enemy Command.
art_subject: A sly eunuch in black court robes and a tall hat clutching sealed memorials to his chest in flickering lantern light.

valve_text: Modify Pit Fighter of Quoidge with +2 Attack after an allied neighbor dies.
zh_text: 一个友方邻位单位阵亡后，永久使哀兵+2攻击。
en_text: Permanently give Grieving Host +2 attack after an allied neighbor dies.
rationale: 哀兵必胜: an army mourning its dead fights harder. It gains attack each time a neighbouring ally falls.
art_subject: A scarred soldier in a white mourning headband over black armour gripping a broken banner pole among fallen comrades.

valve_text: Play Effect: Deal 4 damage to the enemy tower.
zh_text: 出场效果：对敌方城楼造成4点伤害。
en_text: Play effect: deal 4 damage to the enemy tower.
rationale: The Baibo bandits of Hedong raided towns on sight: they arrive and damage the tower immediately.
art_subject: A ragged bandit with a flaming torch and an axe hacking at a studded town gate.

valve_text: Active 1: Condemn Ravenous Mass's allied neighbors. Modify Ravenous Mass with their Attack and Health.
zh_text: 吞并：处斩饥军的友方邻位单位，并永久使饥军获得它们的攻击和体力。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text: Devour: condemn Starving Horde's allied neighbors. Permanently give Starving Horde their attack and health. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: Famine armies of the era swallowed their own (the chronicles record 人相食): it consumes its neighbours and takes on their strength.
art_subject: A gaunt mass of starving ragged soldiers pressing together into one hulking, menacing shape under a black sky.

valve_text: Active 1: Choose a combat target for Sister of the Veil.
zh_text: 手刃仇人：为赵娥指定交战目标。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text: Blood Debt: choose a combat target for Zhao E the Avenger. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: Zhao E (三国志 庞淯传 注, 列女传) waited years, then killed her father's murderer in broad daylight: a creep that picks its own target.
art_subject: A young woman in plain mourning robes drawing back her veil, a short blade low at her side, stepping forward through a dusty market street.

valve_text: Active 1: Condemn a random item equipped by the unit blocking Ravenhook. Get gold equal to the base cost of that item.
zh_text: 拦路剪径：处斩阻挡黑山贼的单位所装备的一件随机军备，并获得等同于该军备基础价格的金。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text: Highway Robbery: condemn a random item equipped by the unit blocking Black Mountain Raider. Get gold equal to that item's base cost. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: Zhang Yan's Black Mountain bandits stripped travellers and armies and sold the loot: the blocker's gear becomes gold.
art_subject: A lean mountain raider yanking a bronze-trimmed shield away with a hooked pole, sheer black cliffs behind him.

valve_text: Siege 5. Assassin's Shadow has -2 Attack for each ally.
zh_text: 攻城5。每有一个友方单位，许贡门客-2攻击。
en_text: Siege 5. Xu Gong's Avengers have -2 attack for each ally.
rationale: Xu Gong's retainers hid in the wilds and struck Sun Ce down while he hunted apart from his guard: deadly alone, weaker the more allies are around.
art_subject: A hooded hunter-assassin crouched alone in a misty forest, bow drawn and spear slung across his back.

valve_text: Your tower has +2 Retaliate.
zh_text: 你的城楼+2反击。
en_text: Your tower has +2 retaliate.
rationale: The classic wall defence of the era: logs and boulders rolled down on attackers, which is tower retaliate.
art_subject: Defenders atop a crimson-bannered gate tower heaving huge logs and boulders over the parapet onto ladders and attackers below.

valve_text: After you play a red card, modify a random ally with +1 Attack.
zh_text: 你打出红色牌后，永久使一个随机友方单位+1攻击。
en_text: After you play a red card, permanently give a random ally +1 attack.
rationale: The perilous plank roads into Shu (Li Bai's 蜀道难) could only be walked by the bold. Every red card toughens someone who walks them.
art_subject: A narrow wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff face above a misty gorge, a column of red-bannered soldiers marching along it at sunset.

valve_text: All equipped heroes have +2 Attack and +1 Armor.
zh_text: 所有装备了军备的武将+2攻击、+1护甲。
en_text: All equipped heroes have +2 attack and +1 armor.
rationale: Shu's capital arsenal kept the armies equipped. It boosts every equipped hero, the opponent's included, exactly as Valve's 'all equipped heroes'.
art_subject: The interior of a great timber armoury hall with racks of glaives, spears and lamellar armour gleaming under lantern light, crimson banners hanging from the beams.

valve_text: If there is an allied red hero in this lane, all heroes have +2 Cleave.
zh_text: 若本路中有友方红色武将，所有武将+2横扫。
en_text: If there is an allied red hero in this lane, all heroes have +2 cleave.
rationale: In 演义 battles often open with champions duelling between the lines while both armies watch. A red hero turns the lane into that arena, and every hero cleaves.
art_subject: Two mounted champions clashing in the open ground between two drawn-up armies, dust swirling, crimson and dark banners on either side.

valve_text: After opponent plays a spell, deal 3 damage to the enemy tower.
zh_text: 对手施放计策后，对敌方城楼造成3点伤害。
en_text: After your opponent plays a spell, deal 3 damage to the enemy tower.
rationale: Zhuge Liang's signature. In 演义 he repeatedly turns his rivals' schemes back on them (Zhou Yu's above all): every enemy stratagem backfires on its own tower.
art_subject: Zhuge Liang seated calmly with his feather fan on a river bluff while, across the water, an enemy's own fire boats drift back and set their fleet alight.

valve_text: Your tower has +1 Armor.
zh_text: 你的城楼+1护甲。
en_text: Your tower has +1 armor.
rationale: Sun Shangxiang's signature. 水经注 records a 孙夫人城 near Gong'an, the fort where Liu Bei's armed Wu bride kept her household: a hardened tower.
art_subject: Sun Shangxiang in armour with bow in hand on the battlements of a small riverside fort, armed handmaidens beside her and red banners over the gate.

valve_text: Draw a card after a hero dies.
zh_text: 一名武将阵亡后，摸一张牌。
en_text: Draw a card after a hero dies.
rationale: At Baidi City the dying Liu Bei entrusted his son and his realm to Zhuge Liang. Each death passes something on (a card).
art_subject: A walled citadel on a cliff above the Yangtze gorges at dusk, lanterns glowing in its halls and mist rising off the river below.

valve_text: Active 1: Choose an ally. Choose a combat target for it.
zh_text: 传令：选择一个友方单位，为其指定交战目标。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text: Relay Orders: choose an ally, then choose a combat target for it. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: Han and Wei orders travelled by relay riders between post stations (驿): a cheap work that redirects one ally's attack each round.
art_subject: A Wei relay rider galloping out of a small walled post station at dawn, a fresh horse being saddled at the gate and a sealed order tube on his back.

valve_text: Whenever an enemy improvement enters this lane, draw a card.
zh_text: 每当有敌方营建进入本路，摸一张牌。
en_text: Whenever an enemy improvement enters this lane, draw a card.
rationale: Wei armies kept scout outposts to report every enemy work being built: each enemy improvement in the lane becomes intelligence.
art_subject: Wei scouts crouched on a wooden lookout platform in the pines, one sketching enemy siege works being raised in the valley below.

valve_text: Before the action phase, give a random card in opponent's hand +1 Lock.
zh_text: 行动阶段前，使对手手牌中一张随机牌+1锁定。
en_text: Before the action phase, give a random card in your opponent's hand +1 lock.
rationale: 'Strengthen the walls, strip the fields' was the standard way to starve an invader's momentum: a lasting work that slows one enemy card every round.
art_subject: A strong Wei city wall at dusk with harvested, empty fields and stripped orchards stretching to the horizon, an enemy army camped hungry in the distance.

valve_text: After you play a blue card, deal 1 piercing damage to a random enemy.
zh_text: 你打出一张蓝色牌后，对一个随机敌方单位造成1点穿透伤害。
en_text: After you play a blue card, deal 1 piercing damage to a random enemy.
rationale: Wei re-founded the Imperial Academy in 224 to train its officials. Every blue stratagem gains a scholar's sharp edge.
art_subject: Rows of scholars studying bamboo scrolls in a grand Wei academy hall, cold blue lamplight on lacquered pillars.

valve_text: Deal 1 piercing damage to each enemy before the action phase.
zh_text: 行动阶段前，对每个敌方单位造成1点穿透伤害。
en_text: Deal 1 piercing damage to each enemy before the action phase.
rationale: Guo Jia's signature. His 'ten victories, ten defeats' comparison of Cao Cao and Yuan Shao (三国志 郭嘉传 注) is a lasting edge that grinds every enemy down, armour or not.
art_subject: Guo Jia at a lamp-lit table laying ten black and ten white stones across a map, ghostly enemy banners crumbling at the map's edge.

valve_text: You and your opponent draw an extra card each round.
zh_text: 你与对手每回合各额外摸一张牌。
en_text: You and your opponent draw an extra card each round.
rationale: Xu Shao's monthly appraisals of notable men famously judged Cao Cao 'a capable minister in peace, a treacherous hero in chaos'. Open commentary informs both sides.
art_subject: A crowd of scholars and officials gathered at a Han pavilion as a critic delivers judgements, blank scrolls passed hand to hand under winter morning light.

valve_text: Active 1: Fully restore your tower's Mana.
zh_text: 台上召对：完全恢复你城楼的军令。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text: Court Audience: fully restore your tower's mana. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: Cao Cao's Bronze Sparrow Terrace at Ye was the seat of Wei power and patronage: a monument that refills your Command every round.
art_subject: The towering multi-storey Bronze Sparrow Terrace at Ye under a cold moon, a great bronze sparrow on its roof and lanterns glowing on every level.

valve_text: Summon a Melee Creep into this lane each deployment phase.
zh_text: 每个部署阶段，召唤一名步卒至本路。
en_text: Summon a Foot Soldier into this lane each deployment phase.
rationale: Xu Chu's signature. He brought his clan militia to Cao Cao and led the Tiger Guard (虎卫): a camp that keeps sending out men.
art_subject: A fortified Wei camp at dusk with watchtowers and tiger-striped banners, its gate open as Xu Chu waves a column of guards out to the field.

valve_text: Deal 2 damage to each enemy before the action phase.
zh_text: 行动阶段前，对每个敌方单位造成2点伤害。
en_text: Deal 2 damage to each enemy before the action phase.
rationale: Wei's disciplined massed crossbow companies loosed volley after volley into the whole enemy line: 2 damage to every enemy each round.
art_subject: Ranks of Wei crossbowmen in dark iron lamellar loosing a synchronized volley from behind a fortified rampart, bolts filling a frost-grey sky.

valve_text: Whenever any unit enters this lane, stun it this round.
zh_text: 每当有单位进入本路，本回合眩晕该单位。
en_text: Whenever any unit enters this lane, stun it this round.
rationale: Concealed pitfalls were dug to trap charging horsemen in many novel battles: anything entering the lane is caught and stunned, friend or foe.
art_subject: A charging warhorse and rider plunging into a hidden reed-covered pit lined with stakes on a misty plain, Wei pikemen waiting beyond.

valve_text: Draw a card after the combat phase if your tower was dealt damage this round.
zh_text: 若本回合你的城楼受到伤害，交战阶段后摸一张牌。
en_text: Draw a card after the combat phase if your tower was dealt damage this round.
rationale: Wu lined the Yangtze with beacon towers to report attacks: when your tower is hit, word reaches you as a card.
art_subject: A chain of stone beacon towers along a misty riverbank flaring to life one after another, smoke columns rising into the dusk.

valve_text: After you play a green card, give your tower +3 Regeneration until end of round.
zh_text: 你打出一张绿色牌后，本回合你的城楼+3再生。
en_text: After you play a green card, give your tower +3 regeneration until the end of the round.
rationale: Jiangnan's rice paddies and fisheries, opened up under Wu, fed its walls and garrisons: each green card brings in supplies that restore the tower.
art_subject: Terraced rice paddies and fish ponds below a riverside fort, farmers carrying baskets of rice and fish up to the gate in morning light.

valve_text: Modify allies with +1 Attack before the action phase.
zh_text: 行动阶段前，永久使所有友方单位+1攻击。
en_text: Permanently give allies +1 attack before the action phase.
rationale: Constant naval drilling made Wu's marines the best on the river: the whole army grows stronger every round.
art_subject: Rows of war-junks manoeuvring in formation on a misty river while marines on deck practise spear drills to a commander's flag signals.

valve_text: Before the action phase disarm a random enemy this round.
zh_text: 行动阶段前，本回合使一个随机敌方单位缴械。
en_text: Before the action phase, disarm a random enemy this round.
rationale: Lu Xun's strategy at Yiling: let the invader exhaust himself on your ground. Each round one tired enemy cannot attack.
art_subject: Rested Wu soldiers sitting calmly behind a palisade sharpening blades, while beyond it a column of exhausted enemy soldiers slumps in the summer heat.

valve_text: Your tower has +2 Mana.
zh_text: 你的城楼+2军令。
en_text: Your tower has +2 mana.
rationale: Sun Quan made Jianye (modern Nanjing) his seat and later his imperial capital: a lasting centre of command.
art_subject: A walled riverside capital with tiered palace halls and teal-tiled roofs above the Yangtze, war-junks moored along its quays in evening mist.

valve_text: Allied Melee Creeps have +2 Regeneration.
zh_text: 友方步卒+2再生。
en_text: Allied Foot Soldiers have +2 regeneration.
rationale: Artifact's Melee Creep is the mapped 步卒 token: a field infirmary keeps the common infantry patched up.
art_subject: Inside a lantern-lit army tent, medics bandage ordinary foot soldiers lying on straw mats while herbal steam rises from clay pots.

valve_text: Active 1: Give a unit a Death Shield this round. May only be used if there is an allied green hero in this lane.
zh_text: 天佑：本回合使一个单位获得免死护盾。仅当本路中有友方绿色武将时可用。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text: Heaven's Aid: give a unit a death shield this round. Only usable if there is an allied green hero in this lane. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: An idiom for the fortunate escaping certain death, as Sun Quan repeatedly did; a green general must be present to call down that luck.
art_subject: A falling Wu soldier caught in a shaft of pale light as a spear meant for him snaps aside, beneath a small riverside shrine wrapped in incense smoke.

valve_text: Allies have +1 Armor.
zh_text: 友方单位+1护甲。
en_text: Allies have +1 armor.
rationale: Da Qiao's signature. The sisters' family home at Wan (皖城, modern Qianshan) is still shown with its rouge well: a guarded sanctuary that shelters the whole side.
art_subject: A walled garden manor by a misty river at dusk, Da Qiao in jade silks at the moon gate as Wu guards stand watch along its walls and a small stone well glows with lantern light.

valve_text: Deal 2 piercing damage to the enemy tower before the action phase.
zh_text: 行动阶段前，对敌方城楼造成2点穿透伤害。
en_text: Deal 2 piercing damage to the enemy tower before the action phase.
rationale: A roofed ram that pounds the gate every round: steady piercing tower damage.
art_subject: A hide-roofed battering ram cart slamming into a studded city gate, splinters and dust flying.

valve_text: Active 1: Return an allied hero to the Fountain.
zh_text: 脱身：将一名友方武将召回大营。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text: Slip Away: return an allied hero to the Fountain. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: The last of the Thirty-Six Stratagems, 走为上 (when all else fails, run), was the warlords' constant fallback: pull a hero safely back to camp.
art_subject: A cloaked warlord and a few riders slipping out of a back gate into thick night mist while torches blaze at the front of the camp.

valve_text: After the combat phase, remove a charge from Bitter Enemies. Before the action phase, if there are zero charges on Bitter Enemies, deal 6 damage to both towers.
zh_text: 交战阶段后，移除二袁交恶的1层充能。行动阶段前，若二袁交恶没有充能，对双方城楼各造成6点伤害。
en_text: After the combat phase, remove a charge from Feud of the Yuans. Before the action phase, if it has no charges, deal 6 damage to both towers.
rationale: The half-brothers Yuan Shao and Yuan Shu let their feud simmer until it wrecked both houses: a countdown, then both towers burn.
art_subject: Two richly robed noblemen turning their backs on each other across a cracked courtyard, smoke rising from two fortresses beyond.

valve_text: Active 1: Deal 4 piercing damage to the enemy tower. May only be used if there are no unblocked enemies.
zh_text: 掘地攻城：对敌方城楼造成4点穿透伤害。仅当没有未被阻挡的敌方单位时可用。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text: Undermine: deal 4 piercing damage to the enemy tower. Only usable if there are no unblocked enemies. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: Yuan Shao's sappers tunnelled under Yijing and at Guandu. Digging only works when no free enemy can stop it.
art_subject: A lamp-lit tunnel propped with timber beams running beneath a city wall, diggers hauling earth in baskets.

valve_text: All heroes have +4 Siege.
zh_text: 所有武将+4攻城。
en_text: All heroes have +4 siege.
rationale: The idiom for total mutual ruin, jade and common stone burning together: every hero on both sides becomes a wall-breaker.
art_subject: A city wall engulfed in roaring fire, jade ornaments and stone blocks cracking together in the heat.

valve_text: After you play a black card, modify a random ally with +1 Siege.
zh_text: 你打出一张黑色牌后，永久使一个随机友方单位+1攻城。
en_text: After you play a black card, permanently give a random ally +1 siege.
rationale: Sun Tzu: 兵者，诡道也 (all warfare is deception). Each black scheme sharpens a random ally against the walls.
art_subject: A dim war tent with a map table scattered with black stones and a hidden dagger, a strategist's shadow cast on the canvas.

valve_text:
Add a charge to Revtel Investments after the combat phase.
Active 1: Get 4 gold for each charge. Condemn Revtel Investments.
zh_text:
交战阶段后，为郿坞增加1层充能。
开坞散财：每有1层充能，获得4金，然后处斩郿坞。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text:
Add a charge to Mei Fortress after the combat phase.
Open the Vaults: get 4 gold for each charge, then condemn Mei Fortress. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: Dong Zhuo stockpiled thirty years of grain and treasure at Mei, and it was emptied the day he fell: it hoards round by round and cashes out once.
art_subject: A vault inside high fortress walls overflowing with gold, silk bolts and grain sacks under torchlight.

valve_text: Get 3 gold after the combat phase.
zh_text: 交战阶段后，获得3金。
en_text: Get 3 gold after the combat phase.
rationale: Emperor Ling sold official posts at the Western Garden, a steady stream of money: gold every round.
art_subject: A eunuch weighing gold on bronze scales in a garden pavilion beside an official's hat and a blank seal.

valve_text: Allies deal +2 damage when attacking a tower.
zh_text: 友方单位攻击城楼时额外造成2点伤害。
en_text: Allies deal +2 damage when attacking a tower.
rationale: Sun Jian's signature. In 191 his army was first into Luoyang after beating Dong Zhuo's forces: his whole army hits walls harder.
art_subject: Sun Jian in his red headscarf on a scaling ladder at the burning gate of Luoyang, black-armoured troops swarming up behind him.

valve_text: You can not play spells or creeps while this is the active lane. If there is an allied black hero in this lane, allies have +4 Attack.
zh_text: 本路为当前路时，你不能打出计策或兵卒。若本路中有友方黑色武将，友方单位+4攻击。
en_text: You can't play spells or creeps while this is the active lane. If there is an allied black hero in this lane, allies have +4 attack.
rationale: The lords at Suanzao smeared their lips with blood and swore to fight Dong Zhuo. Once sworn there is no more scheming, only battle under a warlord.
art_subject: Armoured warlords gathered around an altar bowl of blood at night, raising their right hands to swear.

valve_text: Both towers have -2 Mana.
zh_text: 双方城楼-2军令。
en_text: Both towers have -2 mana.
rationale: The Ten Attendants' corruption paralysed the whole Han government: both sides lose Command.
art_subject: Ten eunuchs in black-and-purple robes whispering in a shadowed hall around an empty dragon throne.

valve_text: Active 1: Deal 2 piercing damage to a unit.
zh_text: 连射：对一个单位造成2点穿透伤害。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text: Volley: deal 2 piercing damage to a unit. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: Frame-mounted heavy crossbows guarded Han ramparts: a small piercing shot every round.
art_subject: A massive frame-mounted crossbow on a stone rampart, its bolt cocked and aimed down at the field.

valve_text: Before the action phase, if there are charges on March of the Machines, remove one and deal 2 damage to the enemy tower and 2 damage to each enemy.
zh_text: 行动阶段前，若黄天当立有充能，移除1层充能，并对敌方城楼和每个敌方单位各造成2点伤害。
en_text: Before the action phase, if Yellow Heaven Rises has charges, remove one and deal 2 damage to the enemy tower and 2 damage to each enemy.
rationale: Zhang Jiao's signature. His rebellion rose under the slogan 苍天已死，黄天当立: wave after wave of uprisings strike every enemy and the tower until the charges run out.
art_subject: Zhang Jiao on a stone altar raising his staff under a sky split between dead grey clouds and a blazing yellow dawn, yellow-turbaned crowds surging toward a city below.

valve_text: Active 1: Deal 4 piercing damage to a unit in any lane.
zh_text: 高橹俯射：对任意一路中的一个单位造成4点穿透伤害。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text: Rain from Above: deal 4 piercing damage to a unit in any lane. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: At Guandu Yuan Shao's towering archery platforms let archers shoot anywhere into Cao's camp: a heavy cross-lane piercing shot.
art_subject: A tall wheeled wooden archery tower looming over a camp wall, archers on top loosing arrows downward.

valve_text: Fully heal a unit.
zh_text: 完全恢复一个单位的体力。
en_text: Fully heal a unit.
rationale: Cao Cao's 短歌行: '何以解忧？唯有杜康'. The legendary wine cures every care, so it fully restores a unit.
art_subject: A dark glazed Han wine jar with a red paper seal (no characters), a bronze ladle and a steaming cup on a lacquered camp table by lamplight.

valve_text:
Equipped hero has +4 Health.
Active 2: Choose a combat target for equipped hero.
zh_text:
装备者+4体力。
绝影：为装备者指定交战目标。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text:
Equipped hero gains +4 health.
Jueying: choose a combat target for equipped hero. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: Cao Cao's horse 'Shadowless' carried him out of the Wancheng ambush. A mount (坐骑 slot) that lets its rider pick whom to charge.
art_subject: A lean black warhorse in mid-gallop, so fast its outline blurs into a trailing shadow, riderless saddle with steel-blue tassels.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +4 Health and -3 Bounty.
zh_text: 装备者+4体力、-3赏金。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +4 health and -3 bounty.
rationale: The Han iron tablet inscribed in cinnabar that pardoned its holder: with a lower price on his head, the hero is worth less gold to the enemy.
art_subject: A curved iron tablet inlaid with red cinnabar patterns (no legible script), resting on silk inside an open wooden case.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +4 Health and -2 Armor. The unit blocking equipped hero has -2 Armor.
zh_text: 装备者+4体力、-2护甲。阻挡装备者的单位-2护甲。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +4 health and -2 armor. The unit blocking equipped hero has -2 armor.
rationale: The war drum drives both sides into reckless close combat (一鼓作气), so the hero and its blocker both drop their guard.
art_subject: A huge red-lacquered war drum on a cart with crossed drumsticks resting on its skin.

valve_text:
Equipped hero has +4 Health.
Active 2: Swap equipped hero with another ally.
zh_text:
装备者+4体力。
飞电：将装备者与另一个友方单位交换位置。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text:
Equipped hero gains +4 health.
Lightning Dash: swap equipped hero with another ally. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: Cao Cao's white horse with yellow hooves from the Xutian hunt (演义 ch.20); its lightning speed swaps the rider's place in the line.
art_subject: A white horse with golden-yellow hooves leaping through a crackle of pale lightning across a hunting field.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +4 Health. Modify Stonehall Cloak with "Equipped hero has +2 Health" after the combat phase.
zh_text: 装备者+4体力。交战阶段后，永久使大宛马获得：“装备者+2体力。”
en_text: Equipped hero gains +4 health. Permanently give Ferghana Horse "Equipped hero gains +2 health" after the combat phase.
rationale: The 'heavenly horses' of Dayuan, prized across the Han for stamina that grew with every campaign: the mount gains health after each combat.
art_subject: A muscular chestnut Ferghana horse with a sweat-sheened coat on a windswept frontier ridge, a battered saddle on its back.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +1 Armor and +2 Retaliate.
zh_text: 装备者+1护甲、+2反击。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +1 armor and +2 retaliate.
rationale: Iron caltrops (铁蒺藜) were standard Han field defences; armour studded with them hurts whoever strikes it.
art_subject: A lamellar cuirass bristling with short iron spikes shaped like caltrops, a broken spear tip lodged between the barbs.

valve_text:
Equipped hero has +2 Attack.
Active 1: Condemn a random enemy improvement. May only be used if equipped hero is unblocked.
zh_text:
装备者+2攻击。
流星：处斩一个随机的敌方营建。仅当装备者未被阻挡时可用。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text:
Equipped hero gains +2 attack.
Shooting Star: condemn a random enemy improvement. Only usable if equipped hero is unblocked. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: The chained meteor hammer hurled by Wang Shuang in 演义 ch.97. Swung freely when no one blocks its wielder, it smashes an enemy fortification.
art_subject: A spiked iron ball on a long chain whirling through the air, about to crash into a wooden watchtower.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +2 Attack. Modify Stonehall Pike with "Equipped hero has +1 Attack" after the combat phase.
zh_text: 装备者+2攻击。交战阶段后，永久使百辟刀获得：“装备者+1攻击。”
en_text: Equipped hero gains +2 attack. Permanently give Hundred-Forged Blade "Equipped hero gains +1 attack" after the combat phase.
rationale: Cao Cao's 百辟刀令 records blades folded and forged a hundred times; every battle tempers it further.
art_subject: A gleaming saber with visible folded-steel patterns, glowing orange-hot on an anvil.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +1 Armor. Modify Stonehall Plate with "Equipped hero has +1 Armor" after the combat phase.
zh_text: 装备者+1护甲。交战阶段后，永久使明光铠获得：“装备者+1护甲。”
en_text: Equipped hero gains +1 armor. Permanently give Bright Light Armor "Equipped hero gains +1 armor" after the combat phase.
rationale: The mirror-plated armour Cao Zhi lists among imperial gifts (先帝赐臣铠表): each battle polishes and reinforces it.
art_subject: Armour with two large polished round chest plates reflecting brilliant sunlight, displayed on a stand at dawn.

valve_text:
Equipped hero has +2 Attack and Pierce. 
Equip Effect: Purge your opponent's effects from equipped hero.
zh_text:
装备者+2攻击并具有穿透。
装备效果：驱散对手施加于装备者的所有效果。
en_text:
Equipped hero gains +2 attack and pierce.
Equip effect: purge your opponent's effects from equipped hero.
rationale: The legendary paired swords forged by the Wu smiths Gan Jiang and Mo Ye: their edges pass through armour, and taking them up throws off the enemy's hold. (双股剑 is Liu Bei's hero ability.)
art_subject: A matched pair of straight double-edged swords, one dark and one bright, crossed above a stand, sparks scattering as they slice a glowing thread.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +8 Health.
zh_text: 装备者+8体力。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +8 health.
rationale: Cao Cao gave Guan Yu a brocade battle robe, which he wore under Liu Bei's old green one (演义 ch.25): a plain +8 health.
art_subject: A richly embroidered crimson brocade robe with a fur-trimmed collar, draped over a weapon rack in a general's tent.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +2 Armor.
zh_text: 装备者+2护甲。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +2 armor.
rationale: Overlapping iron scale armour, one step up from the mapped hide armour: the standard mid-tier body armour.
art_subject: A suit of overlapping iron fish-scale plates laced with red cord, displayed on a wooden stand.

valve_text:
Equipped hero has +2 Attack.
Active 2: Deal 2 damage to a unit.
zh_text:
装备者+2攻击。
连发：对一个单位造成2点伤害。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text:
Equipped hero gains +2 attack.
Rapid Fire: deal 2 damage to a unit. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: The repeating crossbow credited to Zhuge Liang is the era's 'firearm': it replaces the musket and shoots a unit for 2.
art_subject: A wooden repeating crossbow with a bolt magazine on top, loosing a bolt across a misty battlefield.

valve_text:
Equipped hero has +2 Attack.
Active 2: Move equipped hero to another lane.
zh_text:
装备者+2攻击。
倚天：将装备者移至另一路。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text:
Equipped hero gains +2 attack.
Heaven's Reach: move equipped hero to another lane. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: Cao Cao's 'Heaven-Reliant' sword, twin of the mapped 青釭剑: its bearer goes wherever the battle needs him.
art_subject: A long straight jian with a jade guard, drawn mid-swing and leaving a streak of light that tears across the sky toward a distant battlefield.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +2 Attack and +4 Cleave.
zh_text: 装备者+2攻击、+4横扫。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +2 attack and +4 cleave.
rationale: Sun Jian's heavy saber in 演义, also a 三国杀 weapon: its wide cuts reach the units beside the target.
art_subject: A broad, heavy single-edged saber with a bronze ring pommel cutting a wide arc, ribbons streaming from the hilt.

valve_text:
Equipped hero has +2 Armor.
Active 1: Deal 6 damage to equipped hero's enemy neighbors and condemn equipped hero.
zh_text:
装备者+2护甲。
同归：对装备者的敌方邻位单位造成6点伤害，然后处斩装备者。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text:
Equipped hero gains +2 armor.
Last Stand: deal 6 damage to equipped hero's enemy neighbors and condemn equipped hero. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: Every warlord kept 死士, warriors sworn to die: the wearer takes those beside him down with him.
art_subject: A scarred black iron cuirass with a blood-red sash tied around it, burning embers swirling around it.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +2 Attack. Get 5 gold after an enemy hero dies. Get 1 gold after an enemy creep dies.
zh_text: 装备者+2攻击。敌方武将阵亡后，获得5金。敌方兵卒阵亡后，获得1金。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +2 attack. Get 5 gold after an enemy hero dies. Get 1 gold after an enemy creep dies.
rationale: The ordinary Han ring-pommel saber, the soldier's tool for taking heads and claiming the rewards for them: gold on kills.
art_subject: A plain iron ring-pommel saber resting on a pile of copper coins and a captured enemy banner.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +2 Armor. Equipped hero's allied neighbors have +1 Armor.
zh_text: 装备者+2护甲。装备者的友方邻位单位+1护甲。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +2 armor. Equipped hero's allied neighbors have +1 armor.
rationale: The 橹 was the Han army's great standing shield (说文: 橹，大盾也), covering the men beside its bearer as well.
art_subject: A tall rectangular wooden pavise painted with a snarling beast face, overlapping with other shields in a guard formation.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +1 Armor. Equipped hero has +1 Armor for each of its attackers. Equipped hero's attackers have -1 Armor.
zh_text: 装备者+1护甲。每有一个单位攻击装备者，装备者+1护甲。攻击装备者的单位-1护甲。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +1 armor, and +1 armor for each of its attackers. Equipped hero's attackers have -1 armor.
rationale: Zhuge Liang's improved 筒袖铠, recorded as stopping even heavy crossbow bolts: the more foes press in, the better it holds.
art_subject: A full-sleeved iron armour deflecting a hail of crossbow bolts, the bolts shattering against its tubular sleeves.

valve_text: Condemn an improvement.
zh_text: 处斩一个营建。
en_text: Condemn an improvement.
rationale: Fire attack (火攻) is the era's answer to fortifications: a jar of oil burns one improvement to the ground.
art_subject: A sealed clay pot of oil with a burning rag fuse, flames licking up toward a palisade and wooden gatehouse at night.

valve_text: Get a random item from the Secret Shop.
zh_text: 从黑市中随机获得一件军备。
en_text: Get a random item from the Secret Shop.
rationale: Guan Yu had to cut through five passes because he lacked a travel pass. With one, every gate opens, including the black market's.
art_subject: A bamboo-and-silk travel pass stamped with a red seal (no characters), held up before a guarded fortress gate that is swinging open.

valve_text:
Equipped hero has +1 Armor.
Active 2: Heal a unit 4.
zh_text:
装备者+1护甲。
狮吼：为一个单位恢复4点体力。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text:
Equipped hero gains +1 armor.
Lion's Breath: heal a unit 4. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: In 三国杀 白银狮子 is the armour that blunts damage and restores health: armour with a healing active.
art_subject: Gleaming silver lamellar armour with a roaring lion-head breastplate, soft white light radiating from the lion's mouth.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +2 Attack and +5 Siege.
zh_text: 装备者+2攻击、+5攻城。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +2 attack and +5 siege.
rationale: Xu Huang's great axe, a 三国杀 weapon whose name means it bites through stone: big siege for battering towers.
art_subject: A massive long-hafted battle axe biting deep into a cracked stone tower wall, chips of masonry flying.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +4 Health and +6 Regeneration.
zh_text: 装备者+4体力、+6再生。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +4 health and +6 regeneration.
rationale: Zhang Jiao's heavenly book, whose talisman water healed the sick and drew millions to the Yellow Turbans: large regeneration.
art_subject: An ancient yellow silk scroll unrolled to reveal glowing talisman patterns (no legible characters), healing mist rising from a bowl of talisman water.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +8 Health. Draw a card after an allied neighbor of equipped hero dies.
zh_text: 装备者+8体力。装备者的一个友方邻位单位阵亡后，摸一张牌。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +8 health. Draw a card after an allied neighbor of equipped hero dies.
rationale: Cao Cao's military manual, written from hard battlefield experience (Zhang Song famously recited it): every fallen comrade adds a lesson.
art_subject: A thick bound bamboo-slip military manual lying open on a war table covered in maps, a candle and a broken arrow beside it (no legible characters).

valve_text:
Equipped hero has +4 Health. Add a charge to Book of the Dead after an allied Melee Creep dies.
Active 2: Summon a Zombie for each charge and remove all charges.
zh_text:
装备者+4体力。一名友方步卒阵亡后，为招魂幡增加1层充能。
招魂：每有1层充能，召唤一名阴兵，然后移除所有充能。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text:
Equipped hero gains +4 health. Add a charge to Soul-Calling Banner after an allied Foot Soldier dies.
Call the Dead: summon a Ghost Soldier for each charge, then remove all charges. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: The 招魂 rite called the souls of the dead back; this banner calls fallen Foot Soldiers back as Ghost Soldiers (the Zombie token). 遁甲天书 is left to Zuo Ci's hero ability.
art_subject: A long tattered white-and-black funeral banner on a staff, streamers drifting in grave mist as pale ghostly shapes gather around it.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +4 Health. Whenever opponent draws a card, give that card +1 Lock if equipped hero is in any lane.
zh_text: 装备者+4体力。只要装备者在任意一路中，对手每摸一张牌，使该牌+1锁定。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +4 health. Whenever your opponent draws a card, give that card +1 lock if equipped hero is in any lane.
rationale: Zhang Heng's Eastern Han armillary sphere read the turning of the heavens; its keeper foresees and delays the enemy's plans.
art_subject: A bronze armillary sphere of interlocking rings and dragon supports, star points glowing as its rings turn.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +2 Armor. Equipped hero's allied neighbors have +3 Armor.
zh_text: 装备者+2护甲。装备者的友方邻位单位+3护甲。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +2 armor. Equipped hero's allied neighbors have +3 armor.
rationale: The Black Tortoise, guardian of the north and symbol of impenetrable defence: the rare, stronger shield aura.
art_subject: A round dark-bronze shield embossed with a tortoise entwined by a serpent, projecting a faint shell-shaped barrier.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +16 Health.
zh_text: 装备者+16体力。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +16 health.
rationale: '人中吕布，马中赤兔.' Red Hare, the greatest mount of the age, is the strongest pure-survivability accessory: double any other mount.
art_subject: A magnificent blood-red warhorse rearing on a hilltop at sunset, mane like flame, ornate saddle and bridle.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +4 Armor.
zh_text: 装备者+4护甲。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +4 armor.
rationale: Full suits of heavy armour were rare: Cao Cao wrote that he had twenty against Yuan Shao's ten thousand. Dark iron 玄甲 is that top-tier plain armour.
art_subject: A complete suit of dark blackened-iron lamellar armour with a full helmet, standing imposingly in torchlight.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +2 Armor. All units have -2 Attack.
zh_text: 装备者+2护甲。所有单位-2攻击。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +2 armor. All units have -2 attack.
rationale: In 三国杀 仁王盾 makes black attacks fizzle: a benevolent ruler's shield that blunts every blade on the field.
art_subject: A broad bronze shield engraved with a serene king's face, a soft golden aura around it.

valve_text:
Equipped hero has +2 Armor.
Active 2: Modify a unit and its allied neighbors with -2 Attack.
zh_text:
装备者+2护甲。
狮威：永久使一个单位及其友方邻位单位-2攻击。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text:
Equipped hero gains +2 armor.
Lion's Dread: permanently give a unit and its allied neighbors -2 attack. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: Ma Chao's terrifying lion helm and beast belt (狮盔兽带, 演义 ch.58): the sight of it unnerves a whole enemy formation for good.
art_subject: A silver helm shaped like a roaring lion's head with a white plume, resting on a dark stand.

valve_text:
Equipped hero has +3 Armor.
Active 2: Get control of an enemy creep.
zh_text:
装备者+3护甲。
慑服：获得一名敌方兵卒的控制权。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text:
Equipped hero gains +3 armor.
Overawe: get control of an enemy creep. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: Lü Bu's 束发紫金冠 is the iconic helm of 演义; its awe makes enemy troops change sides, as men so often did in the chaos.
art_subject: An ornate purple-and-gold warrior's crown with long pheasant tail plumes on a dark stand, glowing in candlelight.

valve_text: Equipped hero has +3 Armor and Rapid Deployment. Your tower has +3 Armor.
zh_text: 装备者+3护甲并具有快速出阵。你的城楼+3护甲。
en_text: Equipped hero gains +3 armor and rapid deployment. Your tower has +3 armor.
rationale: The imperial robe that Yuan Shu and others grasped at: its authority fortifies the tower and calls its wearer back to the field at once.
art_subject: A golden imperial dragon robe displayed on a stand atop a fortified city tower, banners snapping in the wind behind it.

valve_text:
Equipped hero has +4 Attack.
Active 1: Give equipped hero and its allied neighbors +X Regeneration this round where X is half its Attack.
zh_text:
装备者+4攻击。
蛇矛：本回合使装备者及其友方邻位单位+X再生，X为装备者攻击的一半。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text:
Equipped hero gains +4 attack.
Rally: give equipped hero and its allied neighbors +X regeneration this round, where X is half its attack. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: Zhang Fei's eighteen-foot serpent spear (Zhang Fei is the mapped Axe): its bearer's ferocity steadies the comrades at his side.
art_subject: A long spear with a wavy serpent-shaped blade planted upright in the ground, red-banner soldiers rallying around it under a stormy sky.

valve_text: Each item in your Secret Shop costs X less gold, where X is equal to its base cost.
zh_text: 你的黑市中每件军备的价格降低X金，X为其基础价格。
en_text: Each item in your Secret Shop costs X less gold, where X is its base cost.
rationale: The Heirloom Seal that Sun Jian found in Luoyang and Yuan Shu coveted. Whoever holds it commands the realm's treasures: every Secret Shop item becomes free.
art_subject: A square white-jade seal crowned with five coiled dragons, a chipped corner patched in gold, glowing on a pile of treasure (base blank, no characters).

valve_text:
Equipped hero has +4 Health.
Active 2: Summon a Thunderhide Pack.
zh_text:
装备者+4体力。
调兵：召唤一艘楼船。主动技能，冷却2。
en_text:
Equipped hero gains +4 health.
Mobilize: summon a Tower Ship. Active ability; cooldown 2.
rationale: The split bronze tiger tally authorised the mobilisation of troops; matching its halves calls up a Tower Ship (the mapped Thunderhide Pack).
art_subject: Two halves of a gold-inlaid bronze tiger tally joining together above a stand, a great multi-decked tower ship emerging from river mist behind.

valve_text:
Equipped hero has +1 Armor.
Active 1: Move equipped hero's enemy neighbors to random other lanes.
zh_text:
装备者+1护甲。
锁阵：将装备者的敌方邻位单位随机移至其他路。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text:
Equipped hero gains +1 armor.
Lock the Gates: move equipped hero's enemy neighbors to random other lanes. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: Cao Ren's 八门金锁阵 (演义 ch.36), a formation that swallows attackers and spits them out elsewhere: a defensive formation-armour that scatters adjacent enemies.
art_subject: A bird's-eye view of a circular eight-gated troop formation, enemy cavalry being swept through its gates and scattered in different directions.

valve_text:
Equipped hero has +8 Attack and +4 Siege. Condemn each unit equipped hero deals battle damage to.
Active 1: Condemn enemy improvements. Condemn each item equipped by the unit blocking equipped hero.
zh_text:
装备者+8攻击、+4攻城。受到装备者战斗伤害的单位均被处斩。
画戟：处斩所有敌方营建，并处斩阻挡装备者的单位所装备的全部军备。主动技能，冷却1。
en_text:
Equipped hero gains +8 attack and +4 siege. Condemn each unit equipped hero deals battle damage to.
Halberd Sweep: condemn enemy improvements. Condemn each item equipped by the unit blocking equipped hero. Active ability; cooldown 1.
rationale: Lü Bu's painted halberd, reserved by the mapping for the top-tier weapon: at 25 gold the most devastating weapon in the game, cutting down anything it touches.
art_subject: An ornate crescent-bladed halberd with red tassels raised against a thunderous sky, lightning playing along its edge.

valve_text: When Loyal Beast deals battle damage to a unit, modify that unit with -1 Attack.
zh_text: 木兽对一个单位造成战斗伤害时，永久使该单位-1攻击。
en_text: When Wooden Beast deals battle damage to a unit, permanently give that unit -1 attack.
rationale: Token summoned by Huang Yueying's 巧造木兽 (Call of the Wild). Her carved war-beasts maul whatever they hit and leave it weaker for good.
art_subject: A carved wooden war-beast with a lion-like head, painted crimson and bronze-banded, jaws open and gears visible at its joints, lunging forward.

valve_text: Before the action phase, deal 2 piercing damage to a random enemy neighbor of Plague Ward.
zh_text: 行动阶段前，对屯田兵的一个随机敌方邻位单位造成2点穿透伤害。
en_text: Before the action phase, deal 2 piercing damage to a random enemy neighbor of Farm Soldier.
rationale: Token summoned by Deng Ai's 屯田 passive and 屯兵淮南 (Sow Venom). Soldier-farmers of the Wei colonies jab whoever stands beside them with sharpened hoe-spears.
art_subject: A weathered Wei soldier-farmer in a straw rain cape over dark lamellar, thrusting a sharpened hoe-spear, flooded paddies behind him.

zh_text: 兵卒：0攻击，0护甲，8体力。
en_text: Creep: 0 attack, 0 armor, 8 health.
rationale: Token summoned by 濡须筑坞 (Defensive Bloom). The classic barrier of crossed sharpened stakes: no attack, it only blocks.
art_subject: A sturdy wooden cheval-de-frise of crossed sharpened stakes lashed with rope on a muddy riverbank, mist behind it and no figures. Use the item framing.

zh_text: 兵卒：2攻击，0护甲，2体力。
en_text: Creep: 2 attack, 0 armor, 2 health.
rationale: Token summoned by Lu River Veterans (Cursed Satyr) and Soul-Calling Banner (Book of the Dead). The spectral soldiers of folklore and 演义 sorcery.
art_subject: A pale, translucent foot soldier in rotted Han armour marching out of grave mist with a rusted spear.

zh_text: 兵卒：2攻击，0护甲，1体力。
en_text: Creep: 2 attack, 0 armor, 1 health.
rationale: Token summoned by Xun Yu's 驱虎吞狼 (Prey on the Weak): fast, fierce and fragile predators set on the wounded.
art_subject: A lean, snarling tiger with ribs showing, crouched to spring out of tall grass, smoke drifting behind it.
